WITH feb_sessions AS (
  SELECT 
    fullVisitorId,
    date,
    visitId,
    totals.transactions as transactions,
    device.deviceCategory,
    visitStartTime
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170201' AND '20170228'
),
-- Sessions with transactions in Feb 2017
feb_transactions AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM feb_sessions
  WHERE transactions IS NOT NULL
),
-- Get first transaction per visitor in Feb 2017 (earliest date, then earliest visitStartTime)
first_transactions AS (
  SELECT 
    fullVisitorId,
    date as first_transaction_date,
    deviceCategory,
    visitStartTime as first_transaction_starttime,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY fullVisitorId ORDER BY date ASC, visitStartTime ASC) as rn
  FROM feb_transactions
),
-- Get first visit per visitor in Feb 2017
first_visits AS (
  SELECT 
    fullVisitorId,
    MIN(date) as first_visit_date
  FROM feb_sessions
  GROUP BY fullVisitorId
)
SELECT 
  ft.fullVisitorId,
  fv.first_visit_date,
  ft.first_transaction_date,
  DATE_DIFF(PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', ft.first_transaction_date), PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', fv.first_visit_date), DAY) as days_elapsed,
  ft.deviceCategory
FROM first_transactions ft
JOIN first_visits fv ON ft.fullVisitorId = fv.fullVisitorId
WHERE ft.rn = 1
ORDER BY ft.fullVisitorId

SELECT 
  '(direct)' AS traffic_source,
  ROUND((SELECT MAX(daily_rev) FROM (
    SELECT SUM(SAFE_CAST(hp.productRevenue AS FLOAT64) / 1000000) AS daily_rev
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`,
    UNNEST(hits) AS h,
    UNNEST(h.product) AS hp
    WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170101' AND '20170630'
      AND hp.productRevenue IS NOT NULL
      AND hp.productRevenue > 0
      AND trafficSource.source = '(direct)'
    GROUP BY date
  )), 2) AS max_daily_millions,
  ROUND((SELECT MAX(weekly_rev) FROM (
    SELECT SUM(SAFE_CAST(hp.productRevenue AS FLOAT64) / 1000000) AS weekly_rev
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`,
    UNNEST(hits) AS h,
    UNNEST(h.product) AS hp
    WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170101' AND '20170630'
      AND hp.productRevenue IS NOT NULL
      AND hp.productRevenue > 0
      AND trafficSource.source = '(direct)'
    GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC(PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', date), WEEK(MONDAY))
  )), 2) AS max_weekly_millions,
  ROUND((SELECT MAX(monthly_rev) FROM (
    SELECT SUM(SAFE_CAST(hp.productRevenue AS FLOAT64) / 1000000) AS monthly_rev
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`,
    UNNEST(hits) AS h,
    UNNEST(h.product) AS hp
    WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170101' AND '20170630'
      AND hp.productRevenue IS NOT NULL
      AND hp.productRevenue > 0
      AND trafficSource.source = '(direct)'
    GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC(PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', date), MONTH)
  )), 2) AS max_monthly_millions

SELECT 
  DATE_TRUNC(PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', date), MONTH) as month,
  CASE 
    WHEN totals.transactions >= 1 AND (SELECT MAX(p.productRevenue) FROM UNNEST(hits) AS h CROSS JOIN UNNEST(h.product) AS p LIMIT 1) IS NOT NULL THEN 'purchase'
    WHEN totals.transactions IS NULL AND (SELECT MAX(p.productRevenue) FROM UNNEST(hits) AS h CROSS JOIN UNNEST(h.product) AS p LIMIT 1) IS NULL THEN 'non-purchase'
    ELSE 'other'
  END as session_type,
  AVG(totals.pageviews) as avg_pageviews
FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`
WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170401' AND '20170731'
GROUP BY month, session_type
ORDER BY month, session_type

-- Get the top product
WITH youtube_buyers AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT fullVisitorId
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`,
  UNNEST(hits) AS h
  LEFT JOIN UNNEST(h.product) AS p
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170701' AND '20170731'
    AND LOWER(p.v2ProductCategory) LIKE '%youtube%'
    AND p.productQuantity > 0
),
buyer_products AS (
  SELECT 
    s.fullVisitorId,
    p.v2ProductName,
    p.productSKU,
    p.productQuantity
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*` s,
  UNNEST(s.hits) AS h
  LEFT JOIN UNNEST(h.product) AS p
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170701' AND '20170731'
    AND s.fullVisitorId IN (SELECT fullVisitorId FROM youtube_buyers)
    AND p.v2ProductName IS NOT NULL
    AND LOWER(p.v2ProductName) NOT LIKE '%youtube%'
    AND p.productQuantity > 0
)
SELECT 
  v2ProductName,
  SUM(productQuantity) AS total_quantity
FROM buyer_products
GROUP BY v2ProductName
ORDER BY total_quantity DESC
LIMIT 1

WITH daily_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    date,
    COUNT(*) as daily_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.austin_incidents.incidents_2016`
  WHERE UPPER(descript) = 'PUBLIC INTOXICATION'
  GROUP BY date
),
stats AS (
  SELECT 
    AVG(daily_count) as mean_count,
    STDDEV(daily_count) as stddev_count
  FROM daily_counts
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT 
    d.date,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SAFE_DIVIDE(d.daily_count - s.mean_count, s.stddev_count) DESC) as rnk
  FROM daily_counts d
  CROSS JOIN stats s
)
SELECT FORMAT_DATE('%Y-%m-%d', date) as date
FROM ranked
WHERE rnk = 2

WITH sessions AS (
  SELECT fullVisitorId, visitId, visitStartTime
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170101' AND '20170131'
  AND LOWER(trafficSource.campaign) LIKE '%data share%'
),
all_page_hits AS (
  SELECT s.fullVisitorId, s.visitId, h.hitNumber, h.time, h.page.pagePath
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*` sess
  JOIN sessions s ON sess.fullVisitorId = s.fullVisitorId AND sess.visitId = s.visitId
  CROSS JOIN UNNEST(sess.hits) AS h
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170101' AND '20170131'
  AND h.type = 'PAGE'
),
home_with_next AS (
  SELECT 
    fullVisitorId, visitId, hitNumber, time, pagePath,
    LEAD(pagePath) OVER (PARTITION BY fullVisitorId, visitId ORDER BY hitNumber) AS nextPagePath,
    LEAD(time) OVER (PARTITION BY fullVisitorId, visitId ORDER BY hitNumber) AS next_time
  FROM all_page_hits
),
home_hits AS (
  SELECT 
    fullVisitorId, visitId, hitNumber, time, pagePath, nextPagePath,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(CAST(next_time - time AS FLOAT64), 1000) AS time_spent_seconds
  FROM home_with_next
  WHERE pagePath = '/home'
)
SELECT 
  (SELECT nextPagePath FROM home_hits WHERE nextPagePath IS NOT NULL GROUP BY nextPagePath ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1) AS most_common_next_page,
  CAST(MAX(time_spent_seconds) AS INT64) AS max_time_spent_seconds
FROM home_hits
WHERE nextPagePath IS NOT NULL

WITH monthly_revenue AS (
  SELECT 
    DATE_TRUNC(PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', date), MONTH) as month,
    SUM(totals.totalTransactionRevenue) / 1000000 as monthly_revenue_usd
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170101' AND '20171231'
    AND trafficSource.source = '(direct)'
    AND totals.totalTransactionRevenue IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY month
),
max_min AS (
  SELECT 
    MAX(monthly_revenue_usd) as max_monthly,
    MIN(monthly_revenue_usd) as min_monthly
  FROM monthly_revenue
)
SELECT 
  '(direct)' as traffic_source,
  ROUND((max_monthly - min_monthly) / 1000000, 2) as difference_in_millions
FROM max_min

WITH users_7day AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT user_pseudo_id
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ga4_obfuscated_sample_ecommerce.events_*`,
  UNNEST(event_params) as ep
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20201101' AND '20210131'
    AND ep.key = 'engagement_time_msec'
    AND ep.value.int_value > 0
    AND event_date BETWEEN '20210101' AND '20210107'
),
users_2day AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT user_pseudo_id
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ga4_obfuscated_sample_ecommerce.events_*`,
  UNNEST(event_params) as ep
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20201101' AND '20210131'
    AND ep.key = 'engagement_time_msec'
    AND ep.value.int_value > 0
    AND event_date BETWEEN '20210106' AND '20210107'
)
SELECT COUNT(*) as distinct_pseudo_users
FROM users_7day u7
WHERE u7.user_pseudo_id NOT IN (SELECT user_pseudo_id FROM users_2day)

SELECT 
  FORMAT_DATE('%m-%d', date) as date_mmdd
FROM `bigquery-public-data.covid19_open_data.covid19_open_data`
WHERE country_code = 'US' AND aggregation_level = 0 AND date BETWEEN '2020-03-01' AND '2020-04-30'
ORDER BY 
  CASE 
    WHEN LAG(new_confirmed) OVER (ORDER BY date) > 0 
    THEN SAFE_DIVIDE(new_confirmed - LAG(new_confirmed) OVER (ORDER BY date), LAG(new_confirmed) OVER (ORDER BY date))
    ELSE NULL 
  END DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT 
  provider_city,
  SUM(total_discharges) AS city_discharges,
  SUM(average_total_payments * total_discharges) / SUM(total_discharges) AS weighted_avg_total_payment
FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_medicare.inpatient_charges_2014`
WHERE drg_definition = '470 - MAJOR JOINT REPLACEMENT OR REATTACHMENT OF LOWER EXTREMITY W/O MCC'
  AND provider_city IN ('NEW YORK', 'BOSTON', 'SPRINGFIELD')
GROUP BY provider_city
ORDER BY city_discharges DESC

-- Final query returning exactly 1 row: the route with longest avg bike duration among those faster than taxis
WITH top20_routes AS (
    SELECT 
        start_station_name,
        end_station_name,
        COUNT(*) as trip_count,
        AVG(tripduration) as avg_tripduration,
        ROUND(AVG(start_station_latitude), 3) as start_lat,
        ROUND(AVG(start_station_longitude), 3) as start_lon,
        ROUND(AVG(end_station_latitude), 3) as end_lat,
        ROUND(AVG(end_station_longitude), 3) as end_lon
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.citibike_trips`
    WHERE DATE(starttime) BETWEEN '2016-01-01' AND '2016-12-31'
    GROUP BY start_station_name, end_station_name
    ORDER BY trip_count DESC
    LIMIT 20
),
taxi_coords AS (
    SELECT 
        ROUND(pickup_latitude, 3) as start_lat,
        ROUND(pickup_longitude, 3) as start_lon,
        ROUND(dropoff_latitude, 3) as end_lat,
        ROUND(dropoff_longitude, 3) as end_lon,
        AVG(TIMESTAMP_DIFF(dropoff_datetime, pickup_datetime, SECOND)) as avg_taxi_duration
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.tlc_yellow_trips_2016`
    WHERE pickup_latitude IS NOT NULL AND dropoff_latitude IS NOT NULL
      AND pickup_longitude IS NOT NULL AND dropoff_longitude IS NOT NULL
      AND TIMESTAMP_DIFF(dropoff_datetime, pickup_datetime, SECOND) > 0
    GROUP BY ROUND(pickup_latitude, 3), ROUND(pickup_longitude, 3), 
             ROUND(dropoff_latitude, 3), ROUND(dropoff_longitude, 3)
)
SELECT 
    r.start_station_name,
    r.end_station_name,
    r.avg_tripduration as avg_bike_duration
FROM top20_routes r
JOIN taxi_coords t 
    ON r.start_lat = t.start_lat AND r.start_lon = t.start_lon 
   AND r.end_lat = t.end_lat AND r.end_lon = t.end_lon
WHERE r.avg_tripduration < t.avg_taxi_duration
ORDER BY r.avg_tripduration DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT
  trip_group,
  MIN(ROUND(trip_seconds / 60.0)) AS min_duration_min,
  MAX(ROUND(trip_seconds / 60.0)) AS max_duration_min,
  COUNT(*) AS total_trips,
  AVG(fare) AS avg_fare
FROM (
  SELECT
    trip_seconds,
    fare,
    NTILE(6) OVER (ORDER BY trip_seconds) AS trip_group
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.chicago_taxi_trips.taxi_trips`
  WHERE trip_seconds IS NOT NULL
    AND trip_seconds BETWEEN 0 AND 3600
)
GROUP BY trip_group
ORDER BY trip_group

SELECT 
    ct.geo_id as census_tract,
    AVG(f.transaction_amt) as avg_donation,
    ct.median_income
FROM `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_acs.censustract_2018_5yr` ct
LEFT JOIN `bigquery-public-data.hud_zipcode_crosswalk.zipcode_to_census_tracts` cw
    ON cw.census_tract_geoid = ct.geo_id
LEFT JOIN `bigquery-public-data.fec.indiv20` f
    ON f.zip_code = cw.zip_code AND f.state = 'NY'
WHERE ct.geo_id LIKE '36047%'
GROUP BY ct.geo_id, ct.median_income
ORDER BY ct.geo_id

-- Each evaluation_group has multiple evaluation_types. The question asks for "evaluation type" as a column.
-- Since the question says "one row per evaluation group", I need to pick one evaluation_type per evaluation_group.
--
-- My current approach picks the evaluation_type with the largest subplot_acres for the winning condition.
-- This seems reasonable.
--
-- But let me also consider: maybe the question wants the evaluation_type that is most commonly associated 
-- with the evaluation_group, or the first one alphabetically.
--
-- Actually, re-reading the question: "which top 10 evaluation groups have the largest subplot acres when 
-- considering only the condition with the largest subplot acres within each group"
--
-- This suggests:
-- 1. For each evaluation_group, find the condition with the largest subplot_acres
-- 2. Rank evaluation_groups by that largest subplot_acres
-- 3. Take top 10
--
-- The evaluation_type is just additional info to include. Since the condition appears in all evaluation_types,
-- maybe I should just pick one consistently. Let me use the evaluation_type with the most rows or the first one.
--
-- Actually, I think my current approach is fine - picking the evaluation_type with the largest subplot_acres 
-- for the winning condition. Let me finalize the query.

-- Final query:
WITH condition_acres AS (
    SELECT 
        p.evaluation_group,
        p.evaluation_group_description,
        p.evaluation_type,
        p.evaluation_description,
        c.condition_status_code,
        c.state_code,
        SUM(p.expansion_factor * SAFE_CAST(c.subplot_proportion_unadjusted AS FLOAT64) * SAFE_CAST(p.adjustment_factor_for_the_subplot AS FLOAT64)) as subplot_acres,
        SUM(p.expansion_factor * SAFE_CAST(COALESCE(c.macroplot_proportion_unadjusted, 0) AS FLOAT64) * SAFE_CAST(p.adjustment_factor_for_the_macroplot AS FLOAT64)) as macroplot_acres
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.usfs_fia.condition` c
    LEFT JOIN `bigquery-public-data.usfs_fia.population` p 
        ON c.plot_sequence_number = p.plot_sequence_number
        AND c.inventory_year = p.inventory_year
        AND c.state_code = p.state_code
    WHERE c.inventory_year = 2012
    GROUP BY p.evaluation_group, p.evaluation_group_description, p.evaluation_type, p.evaluation_description, c.condition_status_code, c.state_code
),
group_condition_total AS (
    SELECT 
        evaluation_group,
        evaluation_group_description,
        condition_status_code,
        state_code,
        SUM(subplot_acres) as total_subplot_acres,
        SUM(macroplot_acres) as total_macroplot_acres
    FROM condition_acres
    GROUP BY evaluation_group, evaluation_group_description, condition_status_code, state_code
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT 
        evaluation_group,
        evaluation_group_description,
        condition_status_code,
        state_code,
        total_subplot_acres,
        total_macroplot_acres,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY evaluation_group ORDER BY total_subplot_acres DESC) as rn
    FROM group_condition_total
),
best_per_group AS (
    SELECT * FROM ranked WHERE rn = 1
),
eval_type_ranked AS (
    SELECT 
        ca.evaluation_group,
        ca.evaluation_type,
        ca.evaluation_description,
        ca.state_code,
        ca.condition_status_code,
        ca.subplot_acres,
        ca.macroplot_acres,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ca.evaluation_group ORDER BY ca.subplot_acres DESC) as type_rn
    FROM condition_acres ca
    INNER JOIN best_per_group bg 
        ON ca.evaluation_group = bg.evaluation_group
        AND ca.condition_status_code = bg.condition_status_code
)
SELECT 
    bpg.evaluation_group_description as evaluation_group,
    etr.evaluation_type,
    bpg.condition_status_code,
    etr.evaluation_description,
    CAST(bpg.state_code AS STRING) as state_code,
    bpg.total_macroplot_acres as macroplot_acres,
    bpg.total_subplot_acres as subplot_acres
FROM best_per_group bpg
INNER JOIN eval_type_ranked etr 
    ON bpg.evaluation_group = etr.evaluation_group
    AND bpg.condition_status_code = etr.condition_status_code
    AND etr.type_rn = 1
ORDER BY bpg.total_subplot_acres DESC
LIMIT 10

WITH under20 AS (
  SELECT 
    country_name,
    SUM(population) AS pop_under_20
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_international.midyear_population_agespecific`
  WHERE year = 2020 AND age BETWEEN 0 AND 19
  GROUP BY country_name
)
SELECT 
  u.country_name,
  u.pop_under_20,
  m.midyear_population,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(u.pop_under_20, m.midyear_population) * 100 AS pct_under_20
FROM under20 u
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_international.midyear_population` m 
  ON u.country_name = m.country_name AND m.year = 2020
ORDER BY pct_under_20 DESC
LIMIT 10

SELECT country_name, cumulative_confirmed, cumulative_recovered, ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(cumulative_recovered, cumulative_confirmed) * 100, 2) as recovery_rate FROM `bigquery-public-data.covid19_open_data.covid19_open_data` WHERE date = '2020-05-10' AND aggregation_level = 0 AND cumulative_confirmed > 50000 AND cumulative_recovered IS NOT NULL AND cumulative_recovered <= cumulative_confirmed ORDER BY recovery_rate DESC LIMIT 3

WITH rochester_data AS (
  SELECT 
    CAST(CONCAT(year, '-', mo, '-', da) AS DATE) AS date,
    SAFE_CAST(temp AS FLOAT64) AS temp_f,
    SAFE_CAST(prcp AS FLOAT64) AS prcp_in,
    SAFE_CAST(wdsp AS FLOAT64) AS wdsp_knots
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2019`
  WHERE stn = '725290' 
    AND year = '2019' 
    AND mo IN ('01', '02', '03')
    AND SAFE_CAST(temp AS FLOAT64) != 9999.9
    AND SAFE_CAST(prcp AS FLOAT64) != 99.99
    AND SAFE_CAST(wdsp AS FLOAT64) != 999.9
),
daily AS (
  SELECT
    date,
    ROUND((temp_f - 32) * 5.0 / 9.0, 1) AS temp_c,
    ROUND(prcp_in * 2.54, 1) AS prcp_cm,
    ROUND(wdsp_knots * 0.514444, 1) AS wind_speed_ms
  FROM rochester_data
),
with_ma AS (
  SELECT
    date,
    temp_c,
    prcp_cm,
    wind_speed_ms,
    ROUND(AVG(temp_c) OVER (ORDER BY date ROWS BETWEEN 7 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 1) AS temp_ma8,
    ROUND(AVG(prcp_cm) OVER (ORDER BY date ROWS BETWEEN 7 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 1) AS prcp_ma8,
    ROUND(AVG(wind_speed_ms) OVER (ORDER BY date ROWS BETWEEN 7 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 1) AS wind_ma8
  FROM daily
)
SELECT
  date,
  temp_c,
  prcp_cm,
  wind_speed_ms,
  temp_ma8,
  prcp_ma8,
  wind_ma8,
  ROUND(temp_ma8 - LAG(temp_ma8, 1) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS lag1_temp,
  ROUND(prcp_ma8 - LAG(prcp_ma8, 1) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS lag1_prcp,
  ROUND(wind_ma8 - LAG(wind_ma8, 1) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS lag1_wind,
  ROUND(temp_ma8 - LAG(temp_ma8, 2) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS lag2_temp,
  ROUND(prcp_ma8 - LAG(prcp_ma8, 2) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS lag2_prcp,
  ROUND(wind_ma8 - LAG(wind_ma8, 2) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS lag2_wind,
  ROUND(temp_ma8 - LAG(temp_ma8, 3) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS lag3_temp,
  ROUND(prcp_ma8 - LAG(prcp_ma8, 3) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS lag3_prcp,
  ROUND(wind_ma8 - LAG(wind_ma8, 3) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS lag3_wind,
  ROUND(temp_ma8 - LAG(temp_ma8, 4) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS lag4_temp,
  ROUND(prcp_ma8 - LAG(prcp_ma8, 4) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS lag4_prcp,
  ROUND(wind_ma8 - LAG(wind_ma8, 4) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS lag4_wind,
  ROUND(temp_ma8 - LAG(temp_ma8, 5) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS lag5_temp,
  ROUND(prcp_ma8 - LAG(prcp_ma8, 5) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS lag5_prcp,
  ROUND(wind_ma8 - LAG(wind_ma8, 5) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS lag5_wind,
  ROUND(temp_ma8 - LAG(temp_ma8, 6) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS lag6_temp,
  ROUND(prcp_ma8 - LAG(prcp_ma8, 6) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS lag6_prcp,
  ROUND(wind_ma8 - LAG(wind_ma8, 6) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS lag6_wind,
  ROUND(temp_ma8 - LAG(temp_ma8, 7) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS lag7_temp,
  ROUND(prcp_ma8 - LAG(prcp_ma8, 7) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS lag7_prcp,
  ROUND(wind_ma8 - LAG(wind_ma8, 7) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS lag7_wind,
  ROUND(temp_ma8 - LAG(temp_ma8, 8) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS lag8_temp,
  ROUND(prcp_ma8 - LAG(prcp_ma8, 8) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS lag8_prcp,
  ROUND(wind_ma8 - LAG(wind_ma8, 8) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS lag8_wind
FROM with_ma
WHERE date >= '2019-01-09'
ORDER BY date
SELECT usa_latitude FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_hurricanes.hurricanes`\nWHERE season = '2020' AND basin = 'NA' AND sid = '2020256N11329'\nORDER BY iso_time DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT 
  t.bike_number,
  SUM(
    6371000 * 2 * ASIN(
      SQRT(
        POWER(SIN((s_end.latitude - s_start.latitude) * ACOS(-1) / 180 / 2), 2) +
        COS(s_start.latitude * ACOS(-1) / 180) * COS(s_end.latitude * ACOS(-1) / 180) *
        POWER(SIN((s_end.longitude - s_start.longitude) * ACOS(-1) / 180 / 2), 2)
      )
    )
  ) AS total_distance_meters
FROM `bigquery-public-data.san_francisco.bikeshare_trips` t

WITH same_station_trips AS (

  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.citibike_trips`
  WHERE start_station_id = end_station_id
),
trip_buckets AS (
  SELECT 
    start_station_id,
    trip_date,
    time_bucket,
    COUNT(*) as bucket_count
  FROM same_station_trips
  GROUP BY start_station_id, trip_date, time_bucket
),
group_trips AS (
  SELECT 
    start_station_id,
    trip_date,
    time_bucket,
    bucket_count
  FROM trip_buckets
  WHERE bucket_count > 1
),
group_trip_count AS (
  SELECT 
    start_station_id,
    SUM(bucket_count) as group_trip_count
  FROM group_trips
  GROUP BY start_station_id
),
total_end_trips AS (
  SELECT 
    end_station_id,
    COUNT(*) as total_trips
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.citibike_trips`
  GROUP BY end_station_id
),
station_names AS (
  SELECT 
    start_station_id,
    start_station_name,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY start_station_id ORDER BY cnt DESC) as rn
  FROM (
    SELECT start_station_id, start_station_name, COUNT(*) as cnt
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.citibike_trips`
    GROUP BY start_station_id, start_station_name
  )
)
SELECT

FROM group_trip_count g
JOIN total_end_trips t ON g.start_station_id = t.end_station_id
JOIN station_names sn ON g.start_station_id = sn.start_station_id AND sn.rn = 1

    AND t.mta_tax >= 0
    AND t.fare_amount >= 0

-- Full query with Pearson correlation rounded to 4 decimals - show all rows
WITH daily_temp AS (
  SELECT 
    CONCAT(CAST(year AS STRING), '-', LPAD(mo, 2, '0'), '-', LPAD(da, 2, '0')) as date_str,
    AVG(temp) as avg_temp
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '2008' AND '2017'
    AND stn IN ('725030', '744860') 
    AND temp != 9999.9 
    AND temp IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY date_str
),
daily_complaints AS (
  SELECT 
    CAST(DATE(created_date) AS STRING) as date_str,
    complaint_type,
    COUNT(*) as complaint_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.311_service_requests`
  WHERE created_date >= '2010-01-01' AND created_date < '2018-01-01'
  GROUP BY date_str, complaint_type
),
daily_totals AS (
  SELECT date_str, SUM(complaint_count) as total_daily_complaints
  FROM daily_complaints
  GROUP BY date_str
),
joined AS (
  SELECT 
    dt.date_str,
    dt.avg_temp,
    dc.complaint_type,
    dc.complaint_count,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(dc.complaint_count, dtot.total_daily_complaints) as pct_of_total
  FROM daily_temp dt
  JOIN daily_complaints dc ON dt.date_str = dc.date_str
  JOIN daily_totals dtot ON dt.date_str = dtot.date_str
),
qualifying_types AS (
  SELECT complaint_type
  FROM joined
  GROUP BY complaint_type
  HAVING SUM(complaint_count) > 5000
),
corr_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    j.complaint_type,
    COUNT(*) as n,
    SUM(j.avg_temp) as sum_x,
    SUM(j.complaint_count) as sum_y1,
    SUM(j.avg_temp * j.complaint_count) as sum_xy1,
    SUM(j.avg_temp * j.avg_temp) as sum_x2,
    SUM(j.complaint_count * j.complaint_count) as sum_y1_sq,
    SUM(j.pct_of_total) as sum_y2,
    SUM(j.avg_temp * j.pct_of_total) as sum_xy2,
    SUM(j.pct_of_total * j.pct_of_total) as sum_y2_sq,
    COUNT(DISTINCT j.date_str) as num_days
  FROM joined j
  WHERE j.complaint_type IN (SELECT complaint_type FROM qualifying_types)
  GROUP BY complaint_type
),
corr_results AS (
  SELECT 
    complaint_type,
    num_days as total_days_with_valid_temp,
    sum_y1 as total_complaints,
    ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(
      n * sum_xy1 - sum_x * sum_y1,
      SQRT((n * sum_x2 - sum_x * sum_x) * (n * sum_y1_sq - sum_y1 * sum_y1))
    ), 4) as corr_temp_count,
    ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(
      n * sum_xy2 - sum_x * sum_y2,
      SQRT((n * sum_x2 - sum_x * sum_x) * (n * sum_y2_sq - sum_y2 * sum_y2))
    ), 4) as corr_temp_pct
  FROM corr_stats
)
SELECT 
  complaint_type,
  total_days_with_valid_temp,
  total_complaints,
  corr_temp_count,
  corr_temp_pct
FROM corr_results
WHERE ABS(corr_temp_count) > 0.5 OR ABS(corr_temp_pct) > 0.5
ORDER BY ABS(COALESCE(corr_temp_count, 0)) DESC

WITH 
wind_data AS (
  SELECT CAST(CONCAT(year, '-', mo, '-', da) AS DATE) AS date, SAFE_CAST(wdsp AS FLOAT64) AS wdsp
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2011` WHERE stn = '744860' AND wban = '94789' AND SAFE_CAST(wdsp AS FLOAT64) != 999.9
  UNION ALL SELECT CAST(CONCAT(year, '-', mo, '-', da) AS DATE), SAFE_CAST(wdsp AS FLOAT64) FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2012` WHERE stn = '744860' AND wban = '94789' AND SAFE_CAST(wdsp AS FLOAT64) != 999.9
  UNION ALL SELECT CAST(CONCAT(year, '-', mo, '-', da) AS DATE), SAFE_CAST(wdsp AS FLOAT64) FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2013` WHERE stn = '744860' AND wban = '94789' AND SAFE_CAST(wdsp AS FLOAT64) != 999.9
  UNION ALL SELECT CAST(CONCAT(year, '-', mo, '-', da) AS DATE), SAFE_CAST(wdsp AS FLOAT64) FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2014` WHERE stn = '744860' AND wban = '94789' AND SAFE_CAST(wdsp AS FLOAT64) != 999.9
  UNION ALL SELECT CAST(CONCAT(year, '-', mo, '-', da) AS DATE), SAFE_CAST(wdsp AS FLOAT64) FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2015` WHERE stn = '744860' AND wban = '94789' AND SAFE_CAST(wdsp AS FLOAT64) != 999.9
  UNION ALL SELECT CAST(CONCAT(year, '-', mo, '-', da) AS DATE), SAFE_CAST(wdsp AS FLOAT64) FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2016` WHERE stn = '744860' AND wban = '94789' AND SAFE_CAST(wdsp AS FLOAT64) != 999.9
  UNION ALL SELECT CAST(CONCAT(year, '-', mo, '-', da) AS DATE), SAFE_CAST(wdsp AS FLOAT64) FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2017` WHERE stn = '744860' AND wban = '94789' AND SAFE_CAST(wdsp AS FLOAT64) != 999.9
  UNION ALL SELECT CAST(CONCAT(year, '-', mo, '-', da) AS DATE), SAFE_CAST(wdsp AS FLOAT64) FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2018` WHERE stn = '744860' AND wban = '94789' AND SAFE_CAST(wdsp AS FLOAT64) != 999.9
  UNION ALL SELECT CAST(CONCAT(year, '-', mo, '-', da) AS DATE), SAFE_CAST(wdsp AS FLOAT64) FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2019` WHERE stn = '744860' AND wban = '94789' AND SAFE_CAST(wdsp AS FLOAT64) != 999.9
  UNION ALL SELECT date, SAFE_CAST(wdsp AS FLOAT64) FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2020` WHERE stn = '744860' AND wban = '94789' AND SAFE_CAST(wdsp AS FLOAT64) != 999.9
),
daily_totals AS (
  SELECT EXTRACT(DATE FROM created_date) AS complaint_date, COUNT(*) AS total_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.311_service_requests`
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM created_date) BETWEEN 2011 AND 2020
  GROUP BY EXTRACT(DATE FROM created_date)
),
daily_by_type AS (
  SELECT EXTRACT(DATE FROM created_date) AS complaint_date, complaint_type, COUNT(*) AS type_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.311_service_requests`
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM created_date) BETWEEN 2011 AND 2020
  GROUP BY EXTRACT(DATE FROM created_date), complaint_type
),
qualifying_types AS (
  SELECT complaint_type FROM daily_by_type GROUP BY complaint_type HAVING SUM(type_count) > 3000
),
daily_proportions AS (
  SELECT d.complaint_date, d.complaint_type,
    CAST(d.type_count AS FLOAT64) / CAST(t.total_count AS FLOAT64) AS daily_proportion,
    w.wdsp AS wind_speed
  FROM daily_by_type d
  JOIN daily_totals t ON d.complaint_date = t.complaint_date
  JOIN qualifying_types q ON d.complaint_type = q.complaint_type
  JOIN wind_data w ON d.complaint_date = w.date
),
corr_data AS (
  SELECT complaint_type,
    COUNT(*) AS n,
    SUM(daily_proportion) AS sum_x,
    SUM(wind_speed) AS sum_y,
    SUM(daily_proportion * daily_proportion) AS sum_x2,
    SUM(wind_speed * wind_speed) AS sum_y2,
    SUM(daily_proportion * wind_speed) AS sum_xy
  FROM daily_proportions
  GROUP BY complaint_type
)
SELECT 
  complaint_type,
  ROUND(
    (n * sum_xy - sum_x * sum_y) / 
    NULLIF(SQRT((n * sum_x2 - sum_x * sum_x) * (n * sum_y2 - sum_y * sum_y)), 0),
    4
  ) AS pearson_correlation
FROM corr_data
WHERE n > 1
ORDER BY ABS((n * sum_xy - sum_x * sum_y) / NULLIF(SQRT((n * sum_x2 - sum_x * sum_x) * (n * sum_y2 - sum_y * sum_y)), 0)) DESC
LIMIT 2

-- Final query: average daily Citibike trips by weather condition (rainy vs non-rainy)
-- Using station US1NYKN0025 (Brooklyn 3.1 NW) - nearest station within 50km with valid PRCP data
WITH daily_precip AS (
  SELECT 
    date,
    SUM(value) / 10.0 as total_precip_mm
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ghcn_d.ghcnd_2016`
  WHERE id = 'US1NYKN0025' 
    AND element = 'PRCP'
    AND qflag IS NULL
    AND mflag IS NULL
  GROUP BY date
),
weather_classified AS (
  SELECT 
    date,
    total_precip_mm,
    CASE WHEN total_precip_mm > 5 THEN 'rainy' ELSE 'non-rainy' END as weather_condition
  FROM daily_precip
),
daily_trips AS (
  SELECT 
    DATE(starttime) as trip_date,
    COUNT(*) as num_trips
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.citibike_trips`
  WHERE DATE(starttime) >= '2016-01-01' AND DATE(starttime) <= '2016-12-31'
  GROUP BY DATE(starttime)
)
SELECT 
  w.weather_condition,
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(t.num_trips), COUNT(t.num_trips)), 2) as avg_daily_trips
FROM weather_classified w
INNER JOIN daily_trips t ON w.date = t.trip_date
GROUP BY w.weather_condition

WITH 
-- Count living trees (not dead) in 1995 by species
trees_1995 AS (
  SELECT 
    UPPER(spc_latin) AS species_upper,
    COUNT(*) AS tree_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.tree_census_1995`
  WHERE status != 'Dead'
    AND spc_latin IS NOT NULL
    AND spc_latin != 'UNKNOWN LIVE TREES'
    AND spc_latin != 'PLANTING SITE'
    AND spc_latin != 'STUMP'
    AND spc_latin != 'UNKNOWN STUMP'
  GROUP BY UPPER(spc_latin)
),
-- Count alive trees in 2015 by species
trees_2015 AS (
  SELECT 
    UPPER(spc_latin) AS species_upper,
    COUNT(*) AS tree_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.tree_census_2015`
  WHERE status = 'Alive'
    AND spc_latin IS NOT NULL
    AND spc_latin != ''
  GROUP BY UPPER(spc_latin)
),
-- Get fall colors from tree_species table
species_info AS (
  SELECT 
    UPPER(species_scientific_name) AS species_upper,
    fall_color
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.tree_species`
),
-- Combine: for each species, get the difference
species_diff AS (
  SELECT 
    si.species_upper,
    si.fall_color,
    COALESCE(t195.tree_count, 0) AS count_1995,
    COALESCE(t215.tree_count, 0) AS count_2015,
    COALESCE(t215.tree_count, 0) - COALESCE(t195.tree_count, 0) AS diff
  FROM species_info si
  LEFT JOIN trees_1995 t195 ON si.species_upper = t195.species_upper
  LEFT JOIN trees_2015 t215 ON si.species_upper = t215.species_upper
)
-- Group by fall color and sum the differences
SELECT 
  fall_color,
  SUM(diff) AS total_change
FROM species_diff
WHERE fall_color IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY fall_color
ORDER BY total_change DESC

-- Final query with proper formatting
WITH y1995 AS (
  SELECT 
    REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM(REGEXP_REPLACE(
      REGEXP_REPLACE(UPPER(TRIM(spc_latin)), r' VAR\..*', ''), 
      r' X ', ' ')), r'\s+', ' ') as normalized_spc_latin,
    COUNT(*) as total,
    SUM(CASE WHEN status IN ('Good', 'Excellent', 'Fair', 'Critical', 'Unknown') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as alive,
    SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'Dead' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as dead
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.tree_census_1995`
  WHERE spc_latin IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(spc_latin) != '' AND UPPER(TRIM(spc_latin)) != 'PLANTING SITE'
  GROUP BY normalized_spc_latin
),
species_common AS (
  SELECT normalized_spc_latin, spc_common,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY normalized_spc_latin ORDER BY cnt DESC) as rn
  FROM (
    SELECT 
      REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM(REGEXP_REPLACE(
        REGEXP_REPLACE(UPPER(TRIM(spc_latin)), r' VAR\..*', ''), 
        r' X ', ' ')), r'\s+', ' ') as normalized_spc_latin,
      spc_common,
      COUNT(*) as cnt
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.tree_census_2015`
    WHERE spc_latin IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(spc_latin) != ''
    GROUP BY normalized_spc_latin, spc_common
  )
),
y2015 AS (
  SELECT 
    REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM(REGEXP_REPLACE(
      REGEXP_REPLACE(UPPER(TRIM(spc_latin)), r' VAR\..*', ''), 
      r' X ', ' ')), r'\s+', ' ') as normalized_spc_latin,
    COUNT(*) as total,
    SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'Alive' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as alive,
    SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'Dead' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as dead
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.tree_census_2015`
  WHERE spc_latin IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(spc_latin) != ''
  GROUP BY normalized_spc_latin
)
SELECT 
  y1.normalized_spc_latin as spc_latin,
  COALESCE(sc.spc_common, '') as spc_common,
  SAFE_CAST(y1.total AS INT64) as total_1995,
  SAFE_CAST(y2.total AS INT64) as total_2015,
  SAFE_CAST(y1.alive AS INT64) as alive_1995,
  SAFE_CAST(y2.alive AS INT64) as alive_2015,
  SAFE_CAST(y1.dead AS INT64) as dead_1995,
  SAFE_CAST(y2.dead AS INT64) as dead_2015,
  SAFE_CAST(y2.total - y1.total AS INT64) as total_diff,
  SAFE_CAST(y2.alive - y1.alive AS INT64) as alive_diff,
  SAFE_CAST(y2.dead - y1.dead AS INT64) as dead_diff
FROM y1995 y1
INNER JOIN y2015 y2 ON y1.normalized_spc_latin = y2.normalized_spc_latin
LEFT JOIN species_common sc ON y1.normalized_spc_latin = sc.normalized_spc_latin AND sc.rn = 1
ORDER BY total_diff DESC
LIMIT 10

WITH target_point AS (

target_zips AS (

  FROM `bigquery-public-data.geo_us_boundaries.zip_codes` z, target_point
  WHERE z.state_code = 'WA'
    AND ST_DWITHIN(z.zip_code_geom, target_point.pt, 5 * 1609.344)
),
tract_overlaps AS (
  SELECT 
    tz.zip_code,
    t.geo_id AS tract_geo_id,
    ST_AREA(ST_INTERSECTION(t.tract_geom, tz.zip_code_geom)) AS overlap_area,
    ST_AREA(t.tract_geom) AS tract_area
  FROM target_zips tz
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.geo_census_tracts.census_tracts_washington` t
    ON ST_INTERSECTS(t.tract_geom, tz.zip_code_geom)
  WHERE ST_AREA(ST_INTERSECTION(t.tract_geom, tz.zip_code_geom)) > 0
),
tract_data AS (
  SELECT geo_id, total_pop, income_per_capita
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_acs.censustract_2017_5yr`
),
allocated AS (
  SELECT 
    to2.zip_code,
    to2.tract_geo_id,
    to2.overlap_area,
    to2.tract_area,
    td.total_pop,
    td.income_per_capita,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(to2.overlap_area, to2.tract_area) AS ratio,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(to2.overlap_area, to2.tract_area) * td.total_pop AS allocated_pop,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(to2.overlap_area, to2.tract_area) * td.total_pop * td.income_per_capita AS allocated_total_income
  FROM tract_overlaps to2
  JOIN tract_data td ON to2.tract_geo_id = td.geo_id
)
SELECT 
  zip_code,
  ROUND(SUM(allocated_pop), 0) AS total_population,
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(allocated_total_income), SUM(allocated_pop)), 1) AS avg_individual_income
FROM allocated
GROUP BY zip_code

WITH speed_diff AS (
  SELECT 
    state_number,
    consecutive_number,
    AVG(ABS(CAST(travel_speed AS INT64) - CAST(speed_limit AS INT64))) AS avg_speed_diff
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.nhtsa_traffic_fatalities.vehicle_2016`
  WHERE travel_speed NOT IN (997, 998, 999)
    AND speed_limit NOT IN (98, 99)
    AND travel_speed IS NOT NULL
    AND speed_limit IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY state_number, consecutive_number
),
person_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    state_number,
    consecutive_number,
    COUNT(DISTINCT person_number) AS num_persons,
    SUM(CASE WHEN injury_severity = 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS num_fatalities
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.nhtsa_traffic_fatalities.person_2016`
  GROUP BY state_number, consecutive_number
),
vehicle_primary AS (
  SELECT 
    state_number,
    consecutive_number,
    body_type
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.nhtsa_traffic_fatalities.vehicle_2016`
  WHERE vehicle_number = 1
),
accident_base AS (
  SELECT 
    a.state_number,
    a.consecutive_number,
    a.number_of_drunk_drivers,
    a.day_of_week,
    a.hour_of_crash,
    a.work_zone,
    v.body_type,
    pc.num_persons,
    pc.num_fatalities,
    sd.avg_speed_diff
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.nhtsa_traffic_fatalities.accident_2016` a
  JOIN vehicle_primary v 
    ON a.state_number = v.state_number AND a.consecutive_number = v.consecutive_number
  JOIN person_counts pc
    ON a.state_number = pc.state_number AND a.consecutive_number = pc.consecutive_number
  LEFT JOIN speed_diff sd
    ON a.state_number = sd.state_number AND a.consecutive_number = sd.consecutive_number
  WHERE pc.num_persons > 1
)
SELECT 
  state_number,
  body_type,
  number_of_drunk_drivers,
  day_of_week,
  hour_of_crash,
  CASE WHEN work_zone != 'None' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS work_zone_binary,
  CASE WHEN num_fatalities > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS label,
  CASE 
    WHEN avg_speed_diff IS NULL THEN NULL
    WHEN avg_speed_diff < 20 THEN 0
    WHEN avg_speed_diff < 40 THEN 1
    WHEN avg_speed_diff < 60 THEN 2
    WHEN avg_speed_diff < 80 THEN 3
    ELSE 4
  END AS speed_diff_level
FROM accident_base
LIMIT 15

    state_name,
    SUM(
      expansion_factor 
      * CASE 
          WHEN proportion_basis = 'MACR' AND adjustment_factor_for_the_macroplot > 0 THEN adjustment_factor_for_the_macroplot
          WHEN proportion_basis = 'SUBP' AND adjustment_factor_for_the_subplot > 0 THEN adjustment_factor_for_the_subplot
          ELSE 1.0
        END
      * condition_proportion_unadjusted
    ) as total_acres
  FROM condition_acres
  WHERE condition_status_code = 1
    AND reserved_status_code = 0
    AND site_productivity_class_code BETWEEN 1 AND 6
  GROUP BY state_code, evaluation_group, state_name
  ORDER BY total_acres DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
forestland_acres AS (
  SELECT 
    state_code,
    evaluation_group,
    state_name,
    SUM(
      expansion_factor 
      * CASE 
          WHEN proportion_basis = 'MACR' AND adjustment_factor_for_the_macroplot > 0 THEN adjustment_factor_for_the_macroplot
          WHEN proportion_basis = 'SUBP' AND adjustment_factor_for_the_subplot > 0 THEN adjustment_factor_for_the_subplot
          ELSE 1.0
        END
      * condition_proportion_unadjusted
    ) as total_acres
  FROM condition_acres
  WHERE condition_status_code = 1
  GROUP BY state_code, evaluation_group, state_name
  ORDER BY total_acres DESC
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT 'timberland' as category, CAST(t.state_code AS STRING) as state_code, CAST(t.evaluation_group AS STRING) as evaluation_group, t.state_name, t.total_acres
FROM timberland_acres t

SELECT 'forestland' as category, CAST(f.state_code AS STRING) as state_code, CAST(f.evaluation_group AS STRING) as evaluation_group, f.state_name, f.total_acres

pop AS (

WITH filtered_trips AS (

    FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york_taxi_trips.tlc_yellow_trips_2016` t

      AND t.tip_amount >= 0
      AND t.tolls_amount >= 0
      AND t.mta_tax >= 0
      AND t.fare_amount >= 0
      AND t.total_amount >= 0
),
with_tip_rate AS (

        pickup_location_id,
        CASE 
            WHEN total_amount = 0 THEN 0

no_tip AS (

        pickup_location_id,

)
SELECT 
    z.borough,
    COUNT(*) as total_count,

SELECT DISTINCT start_position FROM `bigquery-public-data.gnomAD.v2_1_1_exomes__chr17` WHERE reference_name = '17' AND start_position BETWEEN 43044295 AND 43170245 AND reference_bases = 'C' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM UNNEST(alternate_bases) ab WHERE ab.alt = 'T') AND variant_type = 'snv' ORDER BY start_position

-- Final summary statistics query
WITH region_variants AS (
  SELECT 
    t.AN,
    (SELECT SUM(ab.AC) FROM UNNEST(t.alternate_bases) ab) as total_ac
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.gnomAD.v3_genomes__chr1` as t
  WHERE t.reference_name = 'chr1' 
    AND t.start_position >= 55039447 
    AND t.end_position <= 55064852
),
gene_symbols AS (
  SELECT STRING_AGG(DISTINCT vep.SYMBOL, ', ' ORDER BY vep.SYMBOL) as distinct_gene_symbols
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.gnomAD.v3_genomes__chr1` as t,
       UNNEST(t.alternate_bases) as ab,
       UNNEST(ab.vep) as vep
  WHERE t.reference_name = 'chr1' 
    AND t.start_position >= 55039447 
    AND t.end_position <= 55064852
    AND vep.SYMBOL IS NOT NULL 
    AND vep.SYMBOL != ''
)
SELECT 
  rv.number_of_variants,
  rv.total_allele_count_AN,
  rv.total_alternate_allele_count,
  gs.distinct_gene_symbols,
  CAST(55064852 - 55039447 AS FLOAT64) / rv.number_of_variants as mutation_density
FROM (
  SELECT 
    COUNT(*) as number_of_variants,
    SUM(AN) as total_allele_count_AN,
    SUM(total_ac) as total_alternate_allele_count
  FROM region_variants
) rv
CROSS JOIN gene_symbols gs

WITH state_pop AS (
  SELECT za.state_name, SUM(p.population) AS pop_total
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_usa.population_by_zip_2010` p
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.utility_us.zipcode_area` za
    ON p.zipcode = za.zipcode
  WHERE p.minimum_age IS NULL AND p.maximum_age IS NULL AND p.gender IS NULL
  GROUP BY za.state_name
),
distracted_2015 AS (
  SELECT 
    a.state_name,
    COUNT(*) AS distracted_accidents
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.nhtsa_traffic_fatalities.distract_2015` d
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.nhtsa_traffic_fatalities.accident_2015` a
    ON d.state_number = a.state_number AND d.consecutive_number = a.consecutive_number
  WHERE d.driver_distracted_by_name NOT IN ('Not Distracted', 'Unknown if Distracted', 'Not Reported')
  GROUP BY a.state_name
),
distracted_2016 AS (
  SELECT 
    a.state_name,
    COUNT(*) AS distracted_accidents
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.nhtsa_traffic_fatalities.distract_2016` d
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.nhtsa_traffic_fatalities.accident_2016` a
    ON d.state_number = a.state_number AND d.consecutive_number = a.consecutive_number
  WHERE d.driver_distracted_by_name NOT IN ('Not Distracted', 'Unknown if Distracted', 'Not Reported')
  GROUP BY a.state_name
),
combined AS (
  SELECT 
    da.state_name,
    2015 AS year,
    da.distracted_accidents,
    sp.pop_total,
    ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(da.distracted_accidents * 100000.0, sp.pop_total), 2) AS rate_per_100k
  FROM distracted_2015 da
  JOIN state_pop sp ON da.state_name = sp.state_name
  
  UNION ALL
  
  SELECT 
    da.state_name,
    2016 AS year,
    da.distracted_accidents,
    sp.pop_total,
    ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(da.distracted_accidents * 100000.0, sp.pop_total), 2) AS rate_per_100k
  FROM distracted_2016 da
  JOIN state_pop sp ON da.state_name = sp.state_name
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT *,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY year ORDER BY rate_per_100k DESC) AS rn
  FROM combined
)
SELECT state_name, year, distracted_accidents, rate_per_100k, rn
FROM ranked
ORDER BY year, rn

-- For each accident in Jan-Aug 2015, count distinct persons and persons with injury_severity = 4
WITH accident_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        a.state_number,
        a.consecutive_number,
        COUNT(DISTINCT p.person_number) as distinct_persons,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.injury_severity = 4 THEN p.person_number END) as severe_injury_count
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.nhtsa_traffic_fatalities.accident_2015` a
    JOIN `bigquery-public-data.nhtsa_traffic_fatalities.person_2015` p 
        ON a.state_number = p.state_number AND a.consecutive_number = p.consecutive_number
    WHERE a.month_of_crash BETWEEN 1 AND 8
    GROUP BY a.state_number, a.consecutive_number
)
SELECT 
    COUNT(*) as total_accidents_with_multiple_persons,
    SUM(CASE WHEN distinct_persons > 1 AND severe_injury_count > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as accidents_with_multiple_severe_injuries,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(CASE WHEN distinct_persons > 1 AND severe_injury_count > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), SUM(CASE WHEN distinct_persons > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) * 100 as percentage
FROM accident_stats

WITH utah_counties AS (
  SELECT geo_id AS geoid, county_name
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.geo_us_boundaries.counties`
  WHERE state_fips_code = '49'
),
employment_2000 AS (
  SELECT geoid, AVG(month3_emplvl_23_construction) AS avg_2000

employment_2018 AS (

  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN 'q1' AND 'q4'
  AND geoid LIKE '49%'
  GROUP BY geoid
)
SELECT 
  uc.county_name,

  e2018.avg_2018,

WITH openaq_2020 AS (
  SELECT city, ROUND(latitude, 2) as lat, ROUND(longitude, 2) as lon, AVG(value) as avg_openaq
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.openaq.global_air_quality`
  WHERE pollutant = 'pm25'
    AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM timestamp) = 2020

  GROUP BY city, lat, lon
),
epa_1990 AS (
  SELECT city_name, ROUND(latitude, 2) as lat, ROUND(longitude, 2) as lon, AVG(arithmetic_mean) as avg_epa

    AND parameter_name = 'Acceptable PM2.5 AQI & Speciation Mass'

WITH storm_points AS (

storm_segments AS (
  SELECT 
    sp1.sid, sp1.name, sp1.iso_time, sp1.latitude, sp1.longitude, sp1.usa_wind,
    sp1.point_num,
    COALESCE(ST_DISTANCE(
      ST_GEOGPOINT(sp1.longitude, sp1.latitude),
      ST_GEOGPOINT(sp2.longitude, sp2.latitude)
    ) / 1000, 0) as segment_distance_km
  FROM storm_points sp1
  LEFT JOIN storm_points sp2 ON sp1.sid = sp2.sid AND sp1.point_num + 1 = sp2.point_num
)
SELECT 
  iso_time,
  latitude,
  longitude,
  usa_wind,
  COALESCE(SUM(segment_distance_km) OVER (ORDER BY iso_time ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING), 0) as cumulative_distance_km
FROM storm_segments
ORDER BY iso_time

patients_with_diagnosis AS (

WITH joined_data AS (
  SELECT 
    p.gene_symbol,
    r.sample_type_name,
    p.protein_abundance_log2ratio AS protein,
    LN(r.fpkm_unstranded + 1) AS expression
  FROM `isb-cgc-bq.CPTAC.quant_proteome_CPTAC_CCRCC_discovery_study_pdc_current` p
  JOIN `isb-cgc-bq.PDC_metadata.aliquot_to_case_mapping_current` a ON p.aliquot_id = a.aliquot_id
  JOIN `isb-cgc-bq.CPTAC.RNAseq_hg38_gdc_current` r ON a.sample_submitter_id = r.sample_barcode AND p.gene_symbol = r.gene_name
  WHERE r.primary_site = 'Kidney' 
    AND r.sample_type_name IN ('Primary Tumor', 'Solid Tissue Normal')
    AND p.protein_abundance_log2ratio IS NOT NULL
    AND r.fpkm_unstranded IS NOT NULL
),
gene_corr AS (
  SELECT 
    gene_symbol,
    sample_type_name,
    (COUNT(*) * SUM(protein * expression) - SUM(protein) * SUM(expression)) 
    / NULLIF(SQRT((COUNT(*) * SUM(protein * protein) - SUM(protein) * SUM(protein)) 
                  * (COUNT(*) * SUM(expression * expression) - SUM(expression) * SUM(expression))), 0) as correlation
  FROM joined_data
  GROUP BY gene_symbol, sample_type_name
  HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
)
SELECT 
  sample_type_name,
  ROUND(AVG(correlation), 6) as avg_correlation
FROM gene_corr
WHERE ABS(correlation) <= 0.5
GROUP BY sample_type_name
ORDER BY sample_type_name

  UNION ALL

    win_school_ncaa AS opponent_school_ncaa,

  FROM `data-to-insights.ncaa.mbb_historical_tournament_games`
  WHERE season >= 2014
  UNION ALL

combined AS (

  LEFT JOIN `data-to-insights.ncaa.feature_engineering` fe_opp

SELECT

  opponent_school_ncaa,
  pace_rank,
  poss_40min,
  pace_rating,

  opp_efficiency_rank,

  opp_efficiency_rank - efficiency_rank AS eff_rank_diff,
  opp_pts_100poss - pts_100poss AS eff_stat_diff,

WITH paad_patients AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT bcr_patient_barcode
  FROM `isb-cgc-bq.pancancer_atlas.Filtered_clinical_PANCAN_patient_with_followup`
  WHERE acronym = 'PAAD'
),
kras_mutations AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ParticipantBarcode as patient_id
  FROM `isb-cgc-bq.pancancer_atlas.Filtered_MC3_MAF_V5_one_per_tumor_sample`
  WHERE Study = 'PAAD' AND Hugo_Symbol = 'KRAS'
),
tp53_mutations AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ParticipantBarcode as patient_id
  FROM `isb-cgc-bq.pancancer_atlas.Filtered_MC3_MAF_V5_one_per_tumor_sample`
  WHERE Study = 'PAAD' AND Hugo_Symbol = 'TP53'
),
patient_status AS (
  SELECT 
    pp.bcr_patient_barcode,
    CASE WHEN k.patient_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as has_kras,
    CASE WHEN t.patient_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as has_tp53
  FROM paad_patients pp
  LEFT JOIN kras_mutations k ON pp.bcr_patient_barcode = k.patient_id
  LEFT JOIN tp53_mutations t ON pp.bcr_patient_barcode = t.patient_id
),
contingency AS (
  SELECT 
    has_kras,
    has_tp53,
    COUNT(*) as observed
  FROM patient_status
  GROUP BY has_kras, has_tp53
),
margins AS (
  SELECT 
    SUM(observed) as total,
    SUM(CASE WHEN has_kras = 1 THEN observed ELSE 0 END) as kras_total,
    SUM(CASE WHEN has_kras = 0 THEN observed ELSE 0 END) as no_kras_total,
    SUM(CASE WHEN has_tp53 = 1 THEN observed ELSE 0 END) as tp53_total,
    SUM(CASE WHEN has_tp53 = 0 THEN observed ELSE 0 END) as no_tp53_total
  FROM contingency
)
SELECT 
  SUM(
    POW(observed - expected, 2) / expected
  ) as chi_squared_statistic
FROM (
  SELECT 
    c.observed,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(
      CASE c.has_kras 
        WHEN 1 THEN m.kras_total ELSE m.no_kras_total END *
      CASE c.has_tp53 
        WHEN 1 THEN m.tp53_total ELSE m.no_tp53_total END,
      m.total
    ) as expected
  FROM contingency c, margins m
)

-- Final calculation: net difference between PAAD patients with both KRAS and TP53 PASS mutations
-- vs those with neither KRAS nor TP53 PASS mutations
WITH paad_patients AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT bcr_patient_barcode as ParticipantBarcode
    FROM `isb-cgc-bq.pancancer_atlas.Filtered_clinical_PANCAN_patient_with_followup`
    WHERE acronym = 'PAAD'
),
paad_mutations AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        ParticipantBarcode,
        Hugo_Symbol
    FROM `isb-cgc-bq.pancancer_atlas.Filtered_MC3_MAF_V5_one_per_tumor_sample`
    WHERE Study = 'PAAD'
        AND Hugo_Symbol IN ('KRAS', 'TP53')
        AND FILTER = 'PASS'
),
patient_gene_status AS (
    SELECT 
        p.ParticipantBarcode,
        MAX(CASE WHEN m.Hugo_Symbol = 'KRAS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as has_kras,
        MAX(CASE WHEN m.Hugo_Symbol = 'TP53' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as has_tp53
    FROM paad_patients p
    LEFT JOIN paad_mutations m ON p.ParticipantBarcode = m.ParticipantBarcode
    GROUP BY p.ParticipantBarcode
)
SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN has_kras = 1 AND has_tp53 = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as patients_with_both,
    SUM(CASE WHEN has_kras = 0 AND has_tp53 = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as patients_with_neither,
    SUM(CASE WHEN has_kras = 1 AND has_tp53 = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - 
    SUM(CASE WHEN has_kras = 0 AND has_tp53 = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as net_difference
FROM patient_gene_status

WITH wustl_l2 AS (

wustl_l3 AS (

),
wustl_l4 AS (

),
l2_levels AS (

l3_levels AS (

l4_levels AS (

all_levels AS (

  UNION ALL
  SELECT * FROM l4_levels

SELECT Imaging_Assay_Type, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT data_level, ', ' ORDER BY data_level) as available_levels

WITH filtered_samples AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT RefNo, CaseNo 
  FROM `mitelman-db.prod.Cytogen` 
  WHERE Morph = '3111' AND Topo = '0401'
),
cyto_events AS (
  SELECT c.Chr, c.Start, c.`End`, c.Type, COUNT(*) as cnt
  FROM `mitelman-db.prod.CytoConverted` c
  JOIN filtered_samples fs ON c.RefNo = fs.RefNo AND c.CaseNo = fs.CaseNo
  GROUP BY c.Chr, c.Start, c.`End`, c.Type
),
cytobands AS (
  SELECT chromosome, cytoband_name, hg38_start, hg38_stop
  FROM `mitelman-db.prod.CytoBands_hg38`
),
mapped AS (
  SELECT ce.Chr, ce.Start, ce.`End`, ce.Type, ce.cnt, cb.cytoband_name
  FROM cyto_events ce
  JOIN cytobands cb ON ce.Chr = cb.chromosome 
    AND ce.Start >= cb.hg38_start 
    AND ce.Start < cb.hg38_stop
)
SELECT cytoband_name, SUM(cnt) as total_cnt FROM mapped
GROUP BY cytoband_name
ORDER BY total_cnt DESC

WITH chr13_loss AS (
  SELECT RefNo, CaseNo, InvNo, Clone, Chr, ChrOrd, Start, `End`
  FROM `mitelman-db.prod.CytoConverted`
  WHERE Chr = 'chr13' AND Type = 'Loss'
    AND Start <= 48481890 AND `End` >= 48303751
),
chr17_loss AS (
  SELECT RefNo, CaseNo, InvNo, Clone, Chr, ChrOrd, Start, `End`
  FROM `mitelman-db.prod.CytoConverted`
  WHERE Chr = 'chr17' AND Type = 'Loss'
    AND Start <= 7687490 AND `End` >= 7668421
),
chr11_gain AS (
  SELECT RefNo, CaseNo, InvNo, Clone, Chr, ChrOrd, Start, `End`
  FROM `mitelman-db.prod.CytoConverted`
  WHERE Chr = 'chr11' AND Type = 'Gain'
    AND Start <= 108369102 AND `End` >= 108223067
),
matching_clones AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT c13.RefNo, c13.CaseNo, c13.InvNo, c13.Clone
  FROM chr13_loss c13
  JOIN chr17_loss c17
    ON c13.RefNo = c17.RefNo AND c13.CaseNo = c17.CaseNo AND c13.InvNo = c17.InvNo AND c13.Clone = c17.Clone
  JOIN chr11_gain c11
    ON c13.RefNo = c11.RefNo AND c13.CaseNo = c11.CaseNo AND c13.InvNo = c11.InvNo AND c13.Clone = c11.Clone
),
chr13_first AS (
  SELECT c13.RefNo, c13.CaseNo, c13.InvNo, c13.Clone, c13.Chr, c13.ChrOrd, c13.Start, c13.`End`
  FROM chr13_loss c13
  JOIN matching_clones mc
    ON c13.RefNo = mc.RefNo AND c13.CaseNo = mc.CaseNo AND c13.InvNo = mc.InvNo AND c13.Clone = mc.Clone
  QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c13.RefNo, c13.CaseNo, c13.InvNo, c13.Clone ORDER BY c13.Start) = 1
),
chr17_first AS (
  SELECT c17.RefNo, c17.CaseNo, c17.InvNo, c17.Clone, c17.Chr, c17.ChrOrd, c17.Start, c17.`End`
  FROM chr17_loss c17
  JOIN matching_clones mc
    ON c17.RefNo = mc.RefNo AND c17.CaseNo = mc.CaseNo AND c17.InvNo = mc.InvNo AND c17.Clone = mc.Clone
  QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c17.RefNo, c17.CaseNo, c17.InvNo, c17.Clone ORDER BY c17.Start) = 1
),
chr11_first AS (
  SELECT c11.RefNo, c11.CaseNo, c11.InvNo, c11.Clone, c11.Chr, c11.ChrOrd, c11.Start, c11.`End`
  FROM chr11_gain c11
  JOIN matching_clones mc
    ON c11.RefNo = mc.RefNo AND c11.CaseNo = mc.CaseNo AND c11.InvNo = mc.InvNo AND c11.Clone = mc.Clone
  QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c11.RefNo, c11.CaseNo, c11.InvNo, c11.Clone ORDER BY c11.Start) = 1
)
SELECT mc.RefNo, mc.CaseNo, mc.InvNo, mc.Clone,
       c13.ChrOrd AS chr13_ord, c13.Start AS chr13_start, c13.`End` AS chr13_end,
       c17.ChrOrd AS chr17_ord, c17.Start AS chr17_start, c17.`End` AS chr17_end,
       c11.ChrOrd AS chr11_ord, c11.Start AS chr11_start, c11.`End` AS chr11_end,
       kc.CloneShort
FROM matching_clones mc
LEFT JOIN chr13_first c13
  ON mc.RefNo = c13.RefNo AND mc.CaseNo = c13.CaseNo AND mc.InvNo = c13.InvNo AND mc.Clone = c13.Clone
LEFT JOIN chr17_first c17
  ON mc.RefNo = c17.RefNo AND mc.CaseNo = c17.CaseNo AND mc.InvNo = c17.InvNo AND mc.Clone = c17.Clone
LEFT JOIN chr11_first c11
  ON mc.RefNo = c11.RefNo AND mc.CaseNo = c11.CaseNo AND mc.InvNo = c11.InvNo AND mc.Clone = c11.Clone
LEFT JOIN `mitelman-db.prod.KaryClone` kc
  ON mc.RefNo = kc.RefNo AND mc.CaseNo = kc.CaseNo AND mc.InvNo = kc.InvNo AND mc.Clone = kc.CloneNo
ORDER BY mc.RefNo, mc.CaseNo, mc.InvNo, mc.Clone

WITH inpatient_costs AS (

-- Final answer: percentage of weather stations with valid temp data for >= 90% of days in 2022
WITH station_days AS (
  SELECT 
    stn,
    COUNT(DISTINCT date) as total_days,
    SUM(CASE WHEN temp IS NOT NULL AND temp != 9999.9 
                AND max IS NOT NULL AND max != 9999.9 
                AND min IS NOT NULL AND min != 9999.9 
             THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as valid_days
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2022`
  WHERE stn != '999999'
  GROUP BY stn
),
station_pct AS (
  SELECT 
    stn,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(valid_days, total_days) as valid_pct
  FROM station_days
)
SELECT 
  SAFE_DIVIDE(
    COUNT(CASE WHEN valid_pct >= 0.9 THEN stn END),
    COUNT(*)
  ) * 100 as percentage
FROM station_pct

SELECT 
  COUNT(*) as matching_rows,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(TIMESTAMP_DIFF(t.dropoff_datetime, t.pickup_datetime, SECOND)), COUNT(*) * 60.0) as avg_trip_duration_minutes,
  MIN(TIMESTAMP_DIFF(t.dropoff_datetime, t.pickup_datetime, SECOND) / 60.0) as min_minutes,
  MAX(TIMESTAMP_DIFF(t.dropoff_datetime, t.pickup_datetime, SECOND) / 60.0) as max_minutes,
  AVG(t.trip_distance) as avg_distance
FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york_taxi_trips.tlc_yellow_trips_2016` t
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.new_york_taxi_trips.taxi_zone_geom` pu
  ON t.pickup_location_id = pu.zone_id
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.new_york_taxi_trips.taxi_zone_geom` do
  ON t.dropoff_location_id = do.zone_id
WHERE t.data_file_year = 2016
  AND t.data_file_month = 2
  AND DATE(t.pickup_datetime) BETWEEN '2016-02-01' AND '2016-02-07'
  AND t.passenger_count > 3
  AND t.trip_distance >= 10
  AND pu.borough = 'Brooklyn'
  AND do.borough = 'Brooklyn'

WITH ranked AS (
  SELECT
    trip_id,
    duration_sec,
    start_date,
    FORMAT_TIMESTAMP('%Y%m', start_date) AS year_month,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY FORMAT_TIMESTAMP('%Y%m', start_date) ORDER BY start_date ASC) AS rn_asc,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY FORMAT_TIMESTAMP('%Y%m', start_date) ORDER BY start_date DESC) AS rn_desc
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.san_francisco.bikeshare_trips`
)
SELECT
  year_month,
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(MAX(CASE WHEN rn_asc = 1 THEN duration_sec END), 60), 2) AS first_duration_minutes,
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(MAX(CASE WHEN rn_desc = 1 THEN duration_sec END), 60), 2) AS last_duration_minutes,
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(MAX(duration_sec), 60), 2) AS highest_duration_minutes,
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(MIN(duration_sec), 60), 2) AS lowest_duration_minutes
FROM ranked
GROUP BY year_month
ORDER BY year_month

WITH season_max AS (

),
peak_teams AS (

  JOIN season_max s ON t.season = s.season

SELECT market as university_name, COUNT(*) as peak_performance_seasons

WITH per_category_yearly AS (

pivoted AS (

ranked AS (

  FROM `bigquery-public-data.baseball.games_post_wide`

),
pitcher_team AS (

    CASE WHEN pitcherId IN (homeBatter1, homeBatter2, homeBatter3, homeBatter4, homeBatter5, homeBatter6, homeBatter7, homeBatter8, homeBatter9,

      THEN homeTeamName ELSE awayTeamName END AS pitcherTeamName

pitcher_team_valid AS (

  WHERE pitcherId IN (homeBatter1, homeBatter2, homeBatter3, homeBatter4, homeBatter5, homeBatter6, homeBatter7, homeBatter8, homeBatter9,
                      homeFielder1, homeFielder2, homeFielder3, homeFielder4, homeFielder5, homeFielder6, homeFielder7, homeFielder8, homeFielder9, homeFielder10, homeFielder11, homeFielder12)
     OR pitcherId IN (awayBatter1, awayBatter2, awayBatter3, awayBatter4, awayBatter5, awayBatter6, awayBatter7, awayBatter8, awayBatter9,
                      awayFielder1, awayFielder2, awayFielder3, awayFielder4, awayFielder5, awayFielder6, awayFielder7, awayFielder8, awayFielder9, awayFielder10, awayFielder11, awayFielder12)

max_speeds AS (

  GROUP BY pitcherTeamId, pitcherTeamName, pitcherId, pitcherFirstName, pitcherLastName
),
ranked AS (

    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY pitcherTeamId ORDER BY max_speed DESC) as rn

ORDER BY pitcherTeamName

temp_data AS (

         SUM(CASE WHEN temp != 9999.9 AND temp IS NOT NULL AND count_temp > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as valid_temp_obs

  GROUP BY stn, wban, year
  UNION ALL
  SELECT stn, wban, year, 
         SUM(CASE WHEN temp != 9999.9 AND temp IS NOT NULL AND count_temp > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as valid_temp_obs

  GROUP BY stn, wban, year

         SUM(CASE WHEN temp != 9999.9 AND temp IS NOT NULL AND count_temp > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as valid_temp_obs
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2015`
  GROUP BY stn, wban, year
  UNION ALL
  SELECT stn, wban, year, 
         SUM(CASE WHEN temp != 9999.9 AND temp IS NOT NULL AND count_temp > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as valid_temp_obs
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2016`
  GROUP BY stn, wban, year
  UNION ALL
  SELECT stn, wban, year, 
         SUM(CASE WHEN temp != 9999.9 AND temp IS NOT NULL AND count_temp > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as valid_temp_obs
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2017`
  GROUP BY stn, wban, year
  UNION ALL
  SELECT stn, wban, year, 
         SUM(CASE WHEN temp != 9999.9 AND temp IS NOT NULL AND count_temp > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as valid_temp_obs
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2018`
  GROUP BY stn, wban, year
  UNION ALL
  SELECT stn, wban, year,

WITH yearly_sales AS (
  SELECT 
    item_number,
    item_description,
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date) AS year,
    SUM(sale_dollars) AS total_revenue
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.iowa_liquor_sales.sales`
  WHERE date >= '2022-01-01' AND date < '2024-01-01'
    AND bottles_sold > 0
  GROUP BY item_number, item_description, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date)
)
SELECT 
  item_number,
  item_description,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(
    SUM(CASE WHEN year = 2022 THEN total_revenue ELSE 0 END),
    1
  ) AS revenue_2022,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(
    SUM(CASE WHEN year = 2023 THEN total_revenue ELSE 0 END),
    1
  ) AS revenue_2023,
  ROUND(
    SAFE_DIVIDE(
      SUM(CASE WHEN year = 2023 THEN total_revenue ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN year = 2022 THEN total_revenue ELSE 0 END),
      SUM(CASE WHEN year = 2022 THEN total_revenue ELSE 0 END)
    ) * 100,
    2
  ) AS yoy_growth_pct
FROM yearly_sales
GROUP BY item_number, item_description
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN year = 2022 THEN total_revenue ELSE 0 END) > 0
ORDER BY yoy_growth_pct DESC
LIMIT 5

WITH plot_tree_info AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT plot_sequence_number, plot_state_code, plot_inventory_year
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.usfs_fia.plot_tree`
),
pop_distinct AS (
    SELECT plot_sequence_number, expansion_factor, 
           adjustment_factor_for_the_subplot, 
           adjustment_factor_for_the_macroplot,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY plot_sequence_number ORDER BY evaluation_sequence_number) as rn
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.usfs_fia.population`
    WHERE evaluation_type = 'EXPCURR'
),
plot_sizes AS (
    SELECT 
        pti.plot_state_code as state_code,
        pti.plot_inventory_year as inventory_year,
        p.expansion_factor * p.adjustment_factor_for_the_subplot * c.condition_proportion_unadjusted as subplot_size,
        p.expansion_factor * p.adjustment_factor_for_the_macroplot * c.condition_proportion_unadjusted as macroplot_size
    FROM plot_tree_info pti
    JOIN `bigquery-public-data.usfs_fia.condition` c ON pti.plot_sequence_number = c.plot_sequence_number
    JOIN (SELECT * FROM pop_distinct WHERE rn = 1) p ON pti.plot_sequence_number = p.plot_sequence_number
    WHERE c.condition_status_code = 1
      AND pti.plot_inventory_year IN (2015, 2016, 2017)
),
state_avg_sizes AS (
    SELECT 
        state_code,
        inventory_year,
        AVG(subplot_size) as avg_subplot_size,
        AVG(macroplot_size) as avg_macroplot_size
    FROM plot_sizes
    GROUP BY state_code, inventory_year
),
subp_max AS (
    SELECT state_code, inventory_year, avg_subplot_size
    FROM state_avg_sizes
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY inventory_year ORDER BY avg_subplot_size DESC) = 1
),
macr_max AS (
    SELECT state_code, inventory_year, avg_macroplot_size
    FROM state_avg_sizes
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY inventory_year ORDER BY avg_macroplot_size DESC) = 1
)
SELECT 'subplot' as plot_type, s.inventory_year, CAST(s.state_code AS STRING) as state_code, s.avg_subplot_size as avg_size
FROM subp_max s
UNION ALL
SELECT 'macroplot' as plot_type, m.inventory_year, CAST(m.state_code AS STRING) as state_code, m.avg_macroplot_size as avg_size
FROM macr_max m
ORDER BY inventory_year, plot_type

WITH top5_2008 AS (

  WHERE year = 2008
  GROUP BY minor_category
  ORDER BY SUM(value) DESC
  LIMIT 5
),
top5_names AS (

  SELECT 'Theft From Motor Vehicle' UNION ALL

  SELECT 'Burglary in a Dwelling' UNION ALL

year_totals AS (

  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(CASE WHEN c.minor_category = 'Theft From Motor Vehicle' THEN c.value ELSE 0 END), yt.total_crimes) * 100, 2) AS theft_from_motor_vehicle_pct,

FROM `bigquery-public-data.london_crime.crime_by_lsoa` c

WITH

WITH sessions AS (

    totals.transactions,

    CASE WHEN totals.transactions >= 1 THEN 'purchase' ELSE 'non_purchase' END AS classification,
    FORMAT_DATE('%Y-%m', DATE_TRUNC(PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', date), MONTH)) AS month

  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170601' AND '20170731'

),
visitor_month_class AS (

    month,
    classification,
    SUM(pageviews) AS total_pageviews
  FROM sessions
  GROUP BY fullVisitorId, month, classification
),
avg_by_group AS (
  SELECT

WITH hourly_trips_2015 AS (
  SELECT 
    z.zip_code,

    EXTRACT(HOUR FROM t.pickup_datetime) as hour,

    ON ST_CONTAINS(z.zip_code_geom, ST_GEOGPOINT(t.pickup_longitude, t.pickup_latitude))
  WHERE t.pickup_datetime >= '2015-01-01'
    AND t.pickup_datetime < '2015-01-02'
    AND t.pickup_longitude IS NOT NULL
    AND t.pickup_latitude IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY z.zip_code, DATE_TRUNC(DATE(t.pickup_datetime), DAY), EXTRACT(HOUR FROM t.pickup_datetime)
),
hourly_trips_2014 AS (
  SELECT 
    z.zip_code,
    DATE_TRUNC(DATE(t.pickup_datetime), DAY) as trip_date,
    EXTRACT(HOUR FROM t.pickup_datetime) as hour,
    COUNT(*) as trip_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.tlc_yellow_trips_2014` t
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.geo_us_boundaries.zip_codes` z
    ON ST_CONTAINS(z.zip_code_geom, ST_GEOGPOINT(t.pickup_longitude, t.pickup_latitude))
  WHERE t.pickup_datetime >= '2014-12-18'
    AND t.pickup_datetime < '2015-01-01'
    AND t.pickup_longitude IS NOT NULL
    AND t.pickup_latitude IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY z.zip_code, DATE_TRUNC(DATE(t.pickup_datetime), DAY), EXTRACT(HOUR FROM t.pickup_datetime)
),
ny_zip_codes AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT zip_code 
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.geo_us_boundaries.zip_codes` 
  WHERE state_code = 'NY'
),
hours AS (
  SELECT 0 as hour UNION ALL SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT 4 
  UNION ALL SELECT 5 UNION ALL SELECT 6 UNION ALL SELECT 7 UNION ALL SELECT 8 UNION ALL SELECT 9
  UNION ALL SELECT 10 UNION ALL SELECT 11 UNION ALL SELECT 12 UNION ALL SELECT 13 UNION ALL SELECT 14
  UNION ALL SELECT 15 UNION ALL SELECT 16 UNION ALL SELECT 17 UNION ALL SELECT 18 UNION ALL SELECT 19
  UNION ALL SELECT 20 UNION ALL SELECT 21 UNION ALL SELECT 22 UNION ALL SELECT 23
),
all_combinations AS (
  SELECT ny.zip_code, h.hour
  FROM ny_zip_codes ny
  CROSS JOIN hours h
),
jan1_data AS (
  SELECT 
    ac.zip_code,
    ac.hour,
    COALESCE(h2015.trip_count, 0) as trip_count
  FROM all_combinations ac
  LEFT JOIN hourly_trips_2015 h2015 
    ON ac.zip_code = h2015.zip_code AND ac.hour = h2015.hour
    AND h2015.trip_date = '2015-01-01'
),
metric_1hr AS (
  SELECT zip_code, hour, trip_count FROM hourly_trips_2014 
  WHERE trip_date = '2014-12-31' AND hour = 23
),
metric_24hr AS (
  SELECT zip_code, hour, trip_count FROM hourly_trips_2014 
  WHERE trip_date = '2014-12-31'
),
metric_168hr AS (
  SELECT zip_code, hour, trip_count FROM hourly_trips_2014 
  WHERE trip_date = '2014-12-25'
),
metric_336hr AS (
  SELECT zip_code, hour, trip_count FROM hourly_trips_2014 
  WHERE trip_date = '2014-12-18'
),
hist_14day AS (
  SELECT zip_code, hour, trip_count 
  FROM hourly_trips_2014 
  WHERE trip_date >= '2014-12-18' AND trip_date < '2015-01-01'
),
hist_21day AS (
  SELECT zip_code, hour, trip_count 
  FROM hourly_trips_2014 
  WHERE trip_date >= '2014-12-11' AND trip_date < '2015-01-01'
),
ma14 AS (
  SELECT zip_code, hour,
    AVG(trip_count) as moving_avg_14day,
    STDDEV(trip_count) as moving_stddev_14day
  FROM hist_14day
  GROUP BY zip_code, hour
),
ma21 AS (
  SELECT zip_code, hour,
    AVG(trip_count) as moving_avg_21day,
    STDDEV(trip_count) as moving_stddev_21day
  FROM hist_21day
  GROUP BY zip_code, hour
),
final AS (
  SELECT 
    j.zip_code,
    j.hour,
    j.trip_count,
    COALESCE(m1hr.trip_count, 0) as trips_1hr_ago,
    COALESCE(m24hr.trip_count, 0) as trips_24hr_ago,
    COALESCE(m168hr.trip_count, 0) as trips_168hr_ago,
    COALESCE(m336hr.trip_count, 0) as trips_336hr_ago,
    ROUND(COALESCE(ma14.moving_avg_14day, 0), 2) as moving_avg_14day,
    ROUND(COALESCE(ma14.moving_stddev_14day, 0), 2) as moving_stddev_14day,
    ROUND(COALESCE(ma21.moving_avg_21day, 0), 2) as moving_avg_21day,
    ROUND(COALESCE(ma21.moving_stddev_21day, 0), 2) as moving_stddev_21day
  FROM jan1_data j
  LEFT JOIN metric_1hr m1hr ON j.zip_code = m1hr.zip_code
  LEFT JOIN metric_24hr m24hr ON j.zip_code = m24hr.zip_code AND j.hour = m24hr.hour
  LEFT JOIN metric_168hr m168hr ON j.zip_code = m168hr.zip_code AND j.hour = m168hr.hour
  LEFT JOIN metric_336hr m336hr ON j.zip_code = m336hr.zip_code AND j.hour = m336hr.hour
  LEFT JOIN ma14 ON j.zip_code = ma14.zip_code AND j.hour = ma14.hour
  LEFT JOIN ma21 ON j.zip_code = ma21.zip_code AND j.hour = ma21.hour
)

        END AS tag

    AND (tags LIKE '%android-layout%' OR tags LIKE '%android-activity%' OR tags LIKE '%android-intent%' OR tags LIKE '%android-edittext%' OR tags LIKE '%android-fragments%' OR tags LIKE '%android-recyclerview%' OR tags LIKE '%listview%' OR tags LIKE '%android-actionbar%' OR tags LIKE '%google-maps%' OR tags LIKE '%android-asynctask%')
),

    FROM filtered

WITH question_data AS (
  SELECT 
    q.id as question_id,
    q.owner_user_id as question_owner,
    q.accepted_answer_id,
    q.view_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_questions` q
),
answer_data AS (
  SELECT 
    a.id as answer_id,
    a.parent_id as question_id,
    a.owner_user_id as answer_owner,
    a.score as answer_score
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_answers` a
),
total_scores AS (
  SELECT 
    question_id,
    SUM(answer_score) as total_score
  FROM answer_data
  GROUP BY question_id
),
ranked_answers AS (
  SELECT 
    ad.answer_id,
    ad.question_id,
    ad.answer_owner,
    ad.answer_score,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY ad.question_id ORDER BY ad.answer_score DESC) as score_rank
  FROM answer_data ad
),
associated_users AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT question_id, question_owner as user_id
  FROM question_data
  
  UNION ALL
  
  SELECT DISTINCT qd.question_id, ad.answer_owner as user_id
  FROM question_data qd
  JOIN answer_data ad ON ad.question_id = qd.question_id AND ad.answer_id = qd.accepted_answer_id
  WHERE ad.answer_owner IS NOT NULL
  
  UNION ALL
  
  SELECT DISTINCT ad.question_id, ad.answer_owner as user_id
  FROM answer_data ad
  WHERE ad.answer_score > 5
  
  UNION ALL
  
  SELECT DISTINCT ad.question_id, ad.answer_owner as user_id
  FROM answer_data ad
  JOIN total_scores ts ON ts.question_id = ad.question_id
  WHERE ad.answer_score > 0 AND ad.answer_score > 0.2 * ts.total_score
  
  UNION ALL
  
  SELECT DISTINCT ra.question_id, ra.answer_owner as user_id
  FROM ranked_answers ra
  WHERE ra.score_rank <= 3
),
user_questions AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT user_id, question_id
  FROM associated_users
  WHERE user_id IS NOT NULL
),
user_view_counts AS (

  FROM user_questions uq
  JOIN question_data qd ON qd.question_id = uq.question_id
  GROUP BY uq.user_id
)
SELECT 
  uvc.user_id,
  u.display_name,
  uvc.total_view_count
FROM user_view_counts uvc

WITH answer_votes AS (

    v.post_id as answer_id,

    SUM(CASE WHEN v.vote_type_id = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as accepted
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.votes` v

),
answer_tags AS (
  SELECT

  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_questions` q
    ON a.parent_id = q.id
  CROSS JOIN UNNEST(SPLIT(q.tags, '|')) as tag
  WHERE a.owner_user_id = 1908967
    AND a.creation_date < TIMESTAMP('2018-06-07')
)
SELECT 
  x.tag,
  SUM(IFNULL(v.upvotes, 0)) as upvote_count,
  SUM(IFNULL(v.accepted, 0)) as accepted_count,
  SUM(IFNULL(v.upvotes, 0)) * 10 
    + SUM(IFNULL(v.accepted, 0)) * 15 as total_score
FROM answer_tags x
LEFT JOIN answer_votes v ON x.answer_id = v.answer_id

ORDER BY total_score DESC
LIMIT 10

-- Full query: questions per day of week in 2021, with count answered within 1 hour
WITH questions_2021 AS (
  SELECT 
    id,
    creation_date,
    FORMAT_TIMESTAMP('%A', creation_date) AS day_name
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_questions`
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM creation_date) = 2021
),
first_answers AS (
  SELECT 
    pa.parent_id AS question_id,
    MIN(pa.creation_date) AS first_answer_date
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_answers` pa
  WHERE pa.parent_id IN (SELECT id FROM questions_2021)
  GROUP BY pa.parent_id
)
SELECT 
  q.day_name,
  COUNT(*) AS total_questions,
  COUNT(fa.first_answer_date) AS answered_count,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(COUNT(fa.first_answer_date), COUNT(*)) * 100 AS percentage_answered_within_1hr
FROM questions_2021 q
LEFT JOIN first_answers fa ON q.id = fa.question_id
  AND TIMESTAMP_DIFF(fa.first_answer_date, q.creation_date, SECOND) BETWEEN 0 AND 3600
GROUP BY q.day_name
ORDER BY 
  CASE q.day_name 
    WHEN 'Monday' THEN 1
    WHEN 'Tuesday' THEN 2
    WHEN 'Wednesday' THEN 3
    WHEN 'Thursday' THEN 4
    WHEN 'Friday' THEN 5
    WHEN 'Saturday' THEN 6
    WHEN 'Sunday' THEN 7
  END

WITH questions_with_accepted AS (
  SELECT id, owner_user_id, body
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_questions`
  WHERE accepted_answer_id IS NOT NULL
),
questions_with_good_answers AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT pq.id, pq.owner_user_id, pq.body
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_answers` pa
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_questions` pq ON pa.parent_id = pq.id
  WHERE pq.accepted_answer_id IS NULL
    AND SAFE_DIVIDE(pa.score, pq.view_count) > 0.01
),
all_qualifying_questions AS (
  SELECT id, owner_user_id, body FROM questions_with_accepted
  UNION DISTINCT
  SELECT id, owner_user_id, body FROM questions_with_good_answers
),
user_badge_counts AS (
  SELECT user_id, COUNT(*) as total_badges
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.badges`
  GROUP BY user_id
)
SELECT 
  aq.id as question_id,
  CHAR_LENGTH(aq.body) as body_length,
  u.reputation,
  u.up_votes - u.down_votes as net_votes,
  COALESCE(ubc.total_badges, 0) as total_badges
FROM all_qualifying_questions aq
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.users` u ON aq.owner_user_id = u.id
LEFT JOIN user_badge_counts ubc ON aq.owner_user_id = ubc.user_id
ORDER BY body_length DESC
LIMIT 10

SELECT COUNT(*) AS country_count
FROM (

  LEFT JOIN `bigquery-public-data.world_bank_health_population.health_nutrition_population` AS health_2017
    ON pop.country_code = health_2017.country_code

  LEFT JOIN `bigquery-public-data.world_bank_health_population.health_nutrition_population` AS health_2018
    ON pop.country_code = health_2018.country_code

  WHERE pop.year_2017 IS NOT NULL

    AND pop.year_2017 > 0
    AND pop.year_2018 > 0
    AND health_2017.value IS NOT NULL
    AND health_2018.value IS NOT NULL
    AND (pop.year_2018 - pop.year_2017) * 1.0 / pop.year_2017 > 0.01

)

WITH region_gdp AS (

),
ranked AS (

WITH co_zip_banks AS (
  SELECT zip_code, COUNT(*) as total_banks
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.fdic_banks.locations`
  WHERE state = 'CO'
  GROUP BY zip_code
),
co_zip_bg_overlap AS (
  SELECT 
    z.zip_code,
    b.geo_id as bg_geo_id,
    ST_AREA(ST_INTERSECTION(z.zip_code_geom, b.blockgroup_geom)) / NULLIF(ST_AREA(b.blockgroup_geom), 0) as overlap_ratio
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.geo_us_boundaries.zip_codes` z
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.geo_census_blockgroups.us_blockgroups_national` b
    ON ST_INTERSECTS(z.zip_code_geom, b.blockgroup_geom)
  WHERE z.state_fips_code = '08'
),
zip_concentration AS (
  SELECT 
    o.zip_code,
    b.total_banks,
    COUNT(o.bg_geo_id) as num_bg,
    SUM(o.overlap_ratio) as total_overlap_ratio,
    SUM(o.overlap_ratio * b.total_banks) / COUNT(o.bg_geo_id) as avg_concentration
  FROM co_zip_bg_overlap o
  JOIN co_zip_banks b ON o.zip_code = b.zip_code
  GROUP BY o.zip_code, b.total_banks
)
SELECT zip_code, ROUND(avg_concentration, 4) as concentration
FROM zip_concentration
ORDER BY avg_concentration DESC
LIMIT 1

WITH tract_changes AS (

        t2011.geo_id,
        t2011.total_pop as pop_2011,

        t2011.median_income as income_2011,
        t2018.median_income as income_2018,

        (t2018.median_income - t2011.median_income) as income_abs_increase
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_acs.censustract_2011_5yr` t2011
    JOIN `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_acs.censustract_2018_5yr` t2018
        ON t2011.geo_id = t2018.geo_id
    WHERE t2011.geo_id LIKE '36047%'
        AND t2011.total_pop > 1000
        AND t2018.total_pop > 1000
),
pop_ranked AS (
    SELECT geo_id, pop_2011, pop_2018, pop_pct_increase,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY pop_pct_increase DESC) as pop_rank
    FROM tract_changes
),
income_ranked AS (
    SELECT geo_id, income_abs_increase, income_2011, income_2018,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY income_abs_increase DESC) as income_rank
    FROM tract_changes
)
SELECT 
    p.geo_id,
    p.pop_rank,
    ROUND(p.pop_pct_increase * 100, 2) as pop_pct_increase_pct,
    p.pop_2011,
    p.pop_2018,
    i.income_rank,
    i.income_abs_increase,
    i.income_2011,
    i.income_2018
FROM pop_ranked p
JOIN income_ranked i ON p.geo_id = i.geo_id
WHERE p.pop_rank <= 20 AND i.income_rank <= 20
ORDER BY p.pop_rank

WITH all_months AS (

  UNION ALL SELECT 7 UNION ALL SELECT 8 UNION ALL SELECT 9 UNION ALL SELECT 10 UNION ALL SELECT 11 UNION ALL SELECT 12
),
monthly_diffs AS (
  SELECT 
    EXTRACT(MONTH FROM end_date) AS month,
    SUM(CASE WHEN subscriber_type = 'Customer' THEN duration_sec ELSE 0 END) / 1000.0 AS customer_minutes_thousands,
    SUM(CASE WHEN subscriber_type = 'Subscriber' THEN duration_sec ELSE 0 END) / 1000.0 AS subscriber_minutes_thousands,
    ABS(
      SUM(CASE WHEN subscriber_type = 'Customer' THEN duration_sec ELSE 0 END) - 
      SUM(CASE WHEN subscriber_type = 'Subscriber' THEN duration_sec ELSE 0 END)

)

  am.month,
  COALESCE(md.abs_diff_minutes_thousands, 0) AS abs_diff_minutes_thousands
FROM all_months am
LEFT JOIN monthly_diffs md ON am.month = md.month
ORDER BY am.month

-- Build the full query:
-- 1. Filter stations: begin <= '20000101' AND end >= '20190630'
-- 2. Count valid days in 2019 (temp, max, min all non-missing)

WITH station_valid_days AS (
  SELECT stn, COUNT(*) as valid_days
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2019`

)
SELECT COUNT(*) as count_stations
FROM qualifying_stations qs
JOIN station_valid_days svd ON qs.usaf = svd.stn
WHERE SAFE_DIVIDE(svd.valid_days, 365) >= 0.90

WITH mountain_view_npis AS (

    healthcare_provider_taxonomy_code_12 as tc12,
    healthcare_provider_taxonomy_code_13 as tc13,
    healthcare_provider_taxonomy_code_14 as tc14,
    healthcare_provider_taxonomy_code_15 as tc15
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.nppes.npi_optimized`
  WHERE npi IN (SELECT npi FROM mountain_view_npis)
),
unpivot_taxonomy AS (
  SELECT npi, tc1 as taxonomy_code FROM npi_taxonomy UNION ALL
  SELECT npi, tc2 FROM npi_taxonomy UNION ALL
  SELECT npi, tc3 FROM npi_taxonomy UNION ALL
  SELECT npi, tc4 FROM npi_taxonomy UNION ALL
  SELECT npi, tc5 FROM npi_taxonomy UNION ALL
  SELECT npi, tc6 FROM npi_taxonomy UNION ALL
  SELECT npi, tc7 FROM npi_taxonomy UNION ALL
  SELECT npi, tc8 FROM npi_taxonomy UNION ALL
  SELECT npi, tc9 FROM npi_taxonomy UNION ALL
  SELECT npi, tc10 FROM npi_taxonomy UNION ALL
  SELECT npi, tc11 FROM npi_taxonomy UNION ALL
  SELECT npi, tc12 FROM npi_taxonomy UNION ALL
  SELECT npi, tc13 FROM npi_taxonomy UNION ALL
  SELECT npi, tc14 FROM npi_taxonomy UNION ALL
  SELECT npi, tc15 FROM npi_taxonomy
),
specialization_counts AS (

top10 AS (

WITH monthly_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    company,
    DATE_TRUNC(CAST(trip_start_timestamp AS DATE), MONTH) AS trip_month,
    COUNT(*) AS trip_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.chicago_taxi_trips.taxi_trips`
  WHERE trip_start_timestamp >= '2018-01-01' 
    AND trip_start_timestamp < '2019-01-01'
    AND company IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY company, DATE_TRUNC(CAST(trip_start_timestamp AS DATE), MONTH)
),
with_lag AS (
  SELECT
    company,
    trip_month,
    trip_count,
    trip_count - LAG(trip_count) OVER (PARTITION BY company ORDER BY trip_month) AS increase
  FROM monthly_counts
),
max_increase_per_company AS (
  SELECT 
    company,
    MAX(increase) AS max_increase
  FROM with_lag
  WHERE increase IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY company
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT 
    company,
    increase,
    trip_month,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY company ORDER BY increase DESC) AS company_rn
  FROM with_lag
  WHERE increase IS NOT NULL
),
top3_companies AS (
  SELECT company
  FROM max_increase_per_company
  ORDER BY max_increase DESC
  LIMIT 3
)
SELECT 
  r.company,
  r.increase,
  FORMAT_DATE('%Y-%m', r.trip_month) AS trip_month
FROM ranked r
JOIN top3_companies t3 ON r.company = t3.company
WHERE r.company_rn = 1
ORDER BY r.increase DESC

WITH trip_data AS (
