    CAST(trip_seconds / 60 AS INT64) AS trip_minutes,
    fare
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.chicago_taxi_trips.taxi_trips`
  WHERE trip_seconds IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(trip_seconds / 60 AS INT64) BETWEEN 1 AND 50
),
with_quantile AS (
  SELECT 
    trip_seconds,
    trip_minutes,
    fare,
    NTILE(10) OVER (ORDER BY trip_seconds) AS qtile
  FROM trip_data
),
grouped AS (
  SELECT 
    qtile,
    MIN(trip_minutes) AS min_min,
    MAX(trip_minutes) AS max_min,
    COUNT(*) AS total_trips,
    ROUND(AVG(fare), 2) AS avg_fare
  FROM with_quantile
  GROUP BY qtile
)
SELECT 
  FORMAT('%02dm to %02dm', min_min, max_min) AS time_range,
  total_trips,
  avg_fare
FROM grouped
ORDER BY min_min

WITH label_art_counts AS (

period_label_counts AS (

WITH living_patient_names AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT p.id as patient_id, n.family as last_name
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.fhir_synthea.patient` p
  CROSS JOIN UNNEST(p.name) as n
  WHERE n.family IS NOT NULL
    AND n.family LIKE 'A%'
    AND (p.deceased IS NULL OR p.deceased.boolean != TRUE)
),
patient_one_condition AS (
  SELECT lpn.patient_id
  FROM living_patient_names lpn
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.fhir_synthea.condition` c
    ON c.subject.patientId = lpn.patient_id
  WHERE c.clinicalStatus = 'active'
  GROUP BY lpn.patient_id
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT c.code.coding[OFFSET(0)].code) = 1
),
patient_condition_map AS (
  SELECT 
    lpn.patient_id,
    c.code.coding[OFFSET(0)].code as condition_code,
    c.code.coding[OFFSET(0)].display as condition_display
  FROM living_patient_names lpn
  JOIN patient_one_condition poc ON lpn.patient_id = poc.patient_id
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.fhir_synthea.condition` c
    ON c.subject.patientId = lpn.patient_id
  WHERE c.clinicalStatus = 'active'
),
patient_meds AS (
  SELECT 
    pcm.patient_id,
    pcm.condition_code,
    pcm.condition_display,
    COUNT(DISTINCT mr.medication.codeableConcept.coding[OFFSET(0)].code) as num_active_meds
  FROM patient_condition_map pcm
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.fhir_synthea.medication_request` mr
    ON mr.subject.patientId = pcm.patient_id
  WHERE mr.status = 'active'
  GROUP BY pcm.patient_id, pcm.condition_code, pcm.condition_display
),
condition_max_meds AS (
  SELECT 
    condition_code,
    condition_display,
    MAX(num_active_meds) as max_distinct_meds
  FROM patient_meds
  GROUP BY condition_code, condition_display
)
SELECT 
  condition_display as condition_name,
  condition_code,
  max_distinct_meds
FROM condition_max_meds
ORDER BY max_distinct_meds DESC, condition_code ASC
LIMIT 8

-- Find the user with the highest gap month number within their activity span
WITH user_monthly_activity AS (
  SELECT 
    `by` as username,
    DATE_TRUNC(DATE(timestamp), MONTH) as activity_month
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.hacker_news.full`
  WHERE timestamp < TIMESTAMP('2024-09-11')
    AND `by` IS NOT NULL
    AND `by` != ''
  GROUP BY `by`, activity_month
),
user_bounds AS (
  SELECT 
    username,
    MIN(activity_month) as first_month,
    MAX(activity_month) as last_month
  FROM user_monthly_activity
  GROUP BY username
),
user_month_ranges AS (
  SELECT 
    ub.username,
    ub.first_month,
    ub.last_month,
    month_date
  FROM user_bounds ub
  CROSS JOIN UNNEST(GENERATE_DATE_ARRAY(ub.first_month, ub.last_month, INTERVAL 1 MONTH)) as month_date
),
gaps AS (
  SELECT 
    umr.username,
    umr.first_month,
    umr.month_date as gap_month
  FROM user_month_ranges umr
  LEFT JOIN user_monthly_activity uma 
    ON uma.username = umr.username 
    AND uma.activity_month = umr.month_date
  WHERE uma.activity_month IS NULL
),
gaps_with_month_num AS (
  SELECT 
    username,
    gap_month,
    DATE_DIFF(gap_month, first_month, MONTH) + 1 as month_number
  FROM gaps
),
max_gap_per_user AS (
  SELECT 
    username,
    MAX(month_number) as max_gap_month_number
  FROM gaps_with_month_num
  GROUP BY username
)
SELECT username, max_gap_month_number
FROM max_gap_per_user
ORDER BY max_gap_month_number DESC
LIMIT 1

WITH monthly_avgs AS (
  SELECT 
    year,
    month,
    AVG(air_temperature) as avg_air,
    AVG(wetbulb_temperature) as avg_wetbulb,
    AVG(dewpoint_temperature) as avg_dewp,
    AVG(sea_surface_temp) as avg_sst
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_icoads.icoads_core_2010`
  WHERE year BETWEEN 2010 AND 2014
    AND air_temperature IS NOT NULL
    AND wetbulb_temperature IS NOT NULL
    AND dewpoint_temperature IS NOT NULL
    AND sea_surface_temp IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY year, month
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 
    year,
    month,
    AVG(air_temperature) as avg_air,
    AVG(wetbulb_temperature) as avg_wetbulb,
    AVG(dewpoint_temperature) as avg_dewp,
    AVG(sea_surface_temp) as avg_sst
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_icoads.icoads_core_2011`
  WHERE year BETWEEN 2010 AND 2014
    AND air_temperature IS NOT NULL
    AND wetbulb_temperature IS NOT NULL
    AND dewpoint_temperature IS NOT NULL
    AND sea_surface_temp IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY year, month
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 
    year,
    month,
    AVG(air_temperature) as avg_air,
    AVG(wetbulb_temperature) as avg_wetbulb,
    AVG(dewpoint_temperature) as avg_dewp,
    AVG(sea_surface_temp) as avg_sst
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_icoads.icoads_core_2012`
  WHERE year BETWEEN 2010 AND 2014
    AND air_temperature IS NOT NULL
    AND wetbulb_temperature IS NOT NULL
    AND dewpoint_temperature IS NOT NULL
    AND sea_surface_temp IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY year, month
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 
    year,
    month,
    AVG(air_temperature) as avg_air,
    AVG(wetbulb_temperature) as avg_wetbulb,
    AVG(dewpoint_temperature) as avg_dewp,
    AVG(sea_surface_temp) as avg_sst
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_icoads.icoads_core_2013`
  WHERE year BETWEEN 2010 AND 2014
    AND air_temperature IS NOT NULL
    AND wetbulb_temperature IS NOT NULL
    AND dewpoint_temperature IS NOT NULL
    AND sea_surface_temp IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY year, month
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 
    year,
    month,
    AVG(air_temperature) as avg_air,
    AVG(wetbulb_temperature) as avg_wetbulb,
    AVG(dewpoint_temperature) as avg_dewp,
    AVG(sea_surface_temp) as avg_sst
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_icoads.icoads_core_2014`
  WHERE year BETWEEN 2010 AND 2014
    AND air_temperature IS NOT NULL
    AND wetbulb_temperature IS NOT NULL
    AND dewpoint_temperature IS NOT NULL
    AND sea_surface_temp IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY year, month
)
SELECT 
  year,
  month,
  SUM(ABS(avg_air - avg_wetbulb) + ABS(avg_air - avg_dewp) + ABS(avg_air - avg_sst) + 
      ABS(avg_wetbulb - avg_dewp) + ABS(avg_wetbulb - avg_sst) + ABS(avg_dewp - avg_sst)) as sum_abs_diff
FROM monthly_avgs
GROUP BY year, month
ORDER BY sum_abs_diff
LIMIT 3

WITH state_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        SUBSTR(CoC_Number, 1, 2) as state_abbr,
        Count_Year,
        SUM(Unsheltered_Homeless) as total_unsheltered
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.sdoh_hud_pit_homelessness.hud_pit_by_coc`
    WHERE Count_Year IN (2015, 2018)
    GROUP BY state_abbr, Count_Year
),
pivoted AS (
    SELECT 
        state_abbr,
        MAX(CASE WHEN Count_Year = 2015 THEN total_unsheltered END) as count_2015,
        MAX(CASE WHEN Count_Year = 2018 THEN total_unsheltered END) as count_2018
    FROM state_counts
    GROUP BY state_abbr
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT Count_Year) = 2
),
with_pct AS (
    SELECT 
        state_abbr,
        count_2015,
        count_2018,
        SAFE_DIVIDE(count_2018 - count_2015, count_2015) * 100 as pct_change
    FROM pivoted
),
national_avg AS (
    SELECT AVG(pct_change) as avg_pct_change
    FROM with_pct
),
with_diff AS (
    SELECT 
        w.state_abbr,
        w.pct_change,
        n.avg_pct_change,
        ABS(w.pct_change - n.avg_pct_change) as abs_diff
    FROM with_pct w, national_avg n
)
SELECT state_abbr
FROM with_diff
ORDER BY abs_diff ASC
LIMIT 5

WITH deduped AS (

),
channel_country_ranked AS (
    SELECT channelGrouping, geoNetwork_country, total_transactions,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY channelGrouping ORDER BY total_transactions DESC) as rn
    FROM channel_country

        GROUP BY channelGrouping 
        HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT geoNetwork_country) > 1

WITH all_forms AS (

  UNION ALL
  SELECT CAST(tax_pd AS STRING), totrevenue, totfuncexpns FROM `bigquery-public-data.irs_990.irs_990_2013`
  UNION ALL
  SELECT CAST(tax_pd AS STRING), totrevenue, totfuncexpns FROM `bigquery-public-data.irs_990.irs_990_2014`
  UNION ALL
  SELECT CAST(tax_pd AS STRING), totrevenue, totfuncexpns FROM `bigquery-public-data.irs_990.irs_990_2015`
  UNION ALL
  SELECT CAST(tax_pd AS STRING), totrevenue, totfuncexpns FROM `bigquery-public-data.irs_990.irs_990_2016`
  UNION ALL
  SELECT CAST(tax_pd AS STRING), totrevenue, totfuncexpns FROM `bigquery-public-data.irs_990.irs_990_2017`

filtered AS (

WITH sorafenib_targets AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT i.target_uniprotID
  FROM `isb-cgc-bq.targetome_versioned.interactions_v1` i
  JOIN `isb-cgc-bq.targetome_versioned.experiments_v1` e ON i.expID = e.expID
  WHERE i.drugID = 157 
    AND i.targetSpecies = 'Homo sapiens'
    AND e.exp_assayValueMedian <= 100
    AND (e.exp_assayValueLow IS NULL OR e.exp_assayValueLow <= 100)
    AND (e.exp_assayValueHigh IS NULL OR e.exp_assayValueHigh <= 100)
),
tas_entities AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT pe.uniprot_id, pe_st.pathway_stable_id
  FROM `isb-cgc-bq.reactome_versioned.pe_to_pathway_v77` pe_st
  JOIN `isb-cgc-bq.reactome_versioned.physical_entity_v77` pe ON pe_st.pe_stable_id = pe.stable_id
  JOIN `isb-cgc-bq.reactome_versioned.pathway_v77` p ON pe_st.pathway_stable_id = p.stable_id
  WHERE pe_st.evidence_code = 'TAS'
    AND p.lowest_level = TRUE
),
all_uniprot_ids AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT uniprot_id FROM tas_entities
),
pathway_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    p.stable_id as pathway_stable_id,
    p.name as pathway_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN te.uniprot_id IN (SELECT target_uniprotID FROM sorafenib_targets) THEN te.uniprot_id END) as targets_within,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN te.uniprot_id NOT IN (SELECT target_uniprotID FROM sorafenib_targets) THEN te.uniprot_id END) as non_targets_within
  FROM (SELECT DISTINCT pathway_stable_id FROM tas_entities) lp
  JOIN `isb-cgc-bq.reactome_versioned.pathway_v77` p ON lp.pathway_stable_id = p.stable_id
  JOIN tas_entities te ON lp.pathway_stable_id = te.pathway_stable_id
  GROUP BY p.stable_id, p.name
),
total_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sorafenib_targets) as total_targets,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM all_uniprot_ids WHERE uniprot_id NOT IN (SELECT target_uniprotID FROM sorafenib_targets)) as total_non_targets
),
with_chi AS (
  SELECT 
    ps.pathway_stable_id,
    ps.pathway_name,
    ps.targets_within,
    tc.total_targets - ps.targets_within as targets_outside,
    ps.non_targets_within,
    tc.total_non_targets - ps.non_targets_within as non_targets_outside,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(
      POWER(
        (ps.targets_within * (tc.total_non_targets - ps.non_targets_within)) - 
        ((tc.total_targets - ps.targets_within) * ps.non_targets_within), 2
      ) * (tc.total_targets + tc.total_non_targets),
      (ps.targets_within + (tc.total_targets - ps.targets_within)) * 
      (ps.non_targets_within + (tc.total_non_targets - ps.non_targets_within)) * 
      (ps.targets_within + ps.non_targets_within) * 
      ((tc.total_targets - ps.targets_within) + (tc.total_non_targets - ps.non_targets_within))
    ) as chi_squared
  FROM pathway_stats ps
  CROSS JOIN total_counts tc
)
SELECT 
  pathway_stable_id,
  pathway_name,
  chi_squared,
  targets_within,
  targets_outside,
  non_targets_within,
  non_targets_outside
FROM with_chi
ORDER BY chi_squared DESC
LIMIT 3

WITH filtered AS (
  SELECT 
    a.activity_id,
    a.assay_id, 
    a.doc_id,
    a.molregno,
    a.standard_relation,
    SAFE_CAST(a.standard_value AS FLOAT64) AS standard_value_f,
    a.standard_type,
    a.potential_duplicate,
    SAFE_CAST(a.pchembl_value AS FLOAT64) AS pchembl_val,
    cs.canonical_smiles,
    SAFE_CAST(cp.heavy_atoms AS INT64) AS heavy_atoms
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ebi_chembl.activities_29` a
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.ebi_chembl.compound_structures_29` cs 
    ON a.molregno = cs.molregno
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.ebi_chembl.compound_properties_29` cp 
    ON a.molregno = cp.molregno
  WHERE SAFE_CAST(cp.heavy_atoms AS INT64) BETWEEN 10 AND 15
    AND a.standard_value IS NOT NULL
    AND a.standard_value != ''
    AND SAFE_CAST(a.pchembl_value AS FLOAT64) > 10
    AND a.potential_duplicate = '0'
),
mol_assay_std AS (
  SELECT 
    molregno,
    assay_id,
    standard_type,
    COUNT(*) AS act_count
  FROM filtered
  GROUP BY molregno, assay_id, standard_type
  HAVING act_count < 5
),
mol_dup_count AS (
  SELECT 
    molregno,
    COUNT(*) AS dup_count
  FROM filtered
  GROUP BY molregno
  HAVING dup_count < 2
),
valid_molecules AS (
  SELECT f.*
  FROM filtered f
  JOIN mol_assay_std mas ON f.molregno = mas.molregno AND f.assay_id = mas.assay_id AND f.standard_type = mas.standard_type
  JOIN mol_dup_count mdc ON f.molregno = mdc.molregno
),
mol_combos AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT molregno, assay_id, standard_type
  FROM valid_molecules
),
pairs AS (
  SELECT 
    mc1.molregno AS molregno_1,
    mc1.assay_id,
    mc1.standard_type,
    mc2.molregno AS molregno_2
  FROM mol_combos mc1
  JOIN mol_combos mc2 
    ON mc1.assay_id = mc2.assay_id 
    AND mc1.standard_type = mc2.standard_type
    AND mc1.molregno < mc2.molregno
),
mol_pair_agg AS (
  SELECT 
    p.molregno_1,
    p.molregno_2,
    p.assay_id,
    p.standard_type,
    vm1.activity_id AS activity_id_1,
    vm1.doc_id AS doc_id_1,
    vm1.standard_value_f AS standard_value_1,
    vm1.standard_relation AS standard_relation_1,
    vm1.canonical_smiles AS smiles_1,
    vm1.heavy_atoms AS heavy_atoms_1,
    vm2.activity_id AS activity_id_2,
    vm2.doc_id AS doc_id_2,
    vm2.standard_value_f AS standard_value_2,
    vm2.standard_relation AS standard_relation_2,
    vm2.canonical_smiles AS smiles_2,
    vm2.heavy_atoms AS heavy_atoms_2
  FROM pairs p
  JOIN valid_molecules vm1 ON p.molregno_1 = vm1.molregno AND p.assay_id = vm1.assay_id AND p.standard_type = vm1.standard_type
  JOIN valid_molecules vm2 ON p.molregno_2 = vm2.molregno AND p.assay_id = vm2.assay_id AND p.standard_type = vm2.standard_type
),
pair_agg AS (
  SELECT 
    molregno_1,
    molregno_2,
    assay_id,
    standard_type,
    GREATEST(MAX(heavy_atoms_1), MAX(heavy_atoms_2)) AS max_heavy_atoms,
    MIN(smiles_1) AS smiles_1,
    MIN(smiles_2) AS smiles_2,
    AVG(standard_value_1) AS avg_std_1,
    AVG(standard_value_2) AS avg_std_2,
    MAX(doc_id_1) AS max_doc_1,
    MAX(doc_id_2) AS max_doc_2,
    STRING_AGG(activity_id_1, ',') AS activity_ids_1,
    STRING_AGG(activity_id_2, ',') AS activity_ids_2
  FROM mol_pair_agg
  GROUP BY molregno_1, molregno_2, assay_id, standard_type
),
pair_docs AS (
  SELECT 
    pa.molregno_1,
    pa.molregno_2,
    pa.assay_id,
    pa.standard_type,
    vm.doc_id
  FROM pair_agg pa
  JOIN valid_molecules vm ON 
    (pa.molregno_1 = vm.molregno AND pa.assay_id = vm.assay_id AND pa.standard_type = vm.standard_type)
    OR
    (pa.molregno_2 = vm.molregno AND pa.assay_id = vm.assay_id AND pa.standard_type = vm.standard_type)
),
docs_with_dates AS (
  SELECT 
    doc_id,
    journal,
    SAFE_CAST(year AS INT64) AS year_val,
    SAFE_CAST(first_page AS INT64) AS first_page_val,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY journal, SAFE_CAST(year AS INT64) ORDER BY SAFE_CAST(first_page AS INT64)) AS rn,
    COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY journal, SAFE_CAST(year AS INT64)) AS grp_cnt
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ebi_chembl.docs_29`
  WHERE year IS NOT NULL AND year != ''
),
pub_dates AS (
  SELECT 
    doc_id,
    year_val,
    CASE 
      WHEN grp_cnt > 1 THEN 
        CAST(year_val AS STRING) || '-' || 
        LPAD(CAST(FLOOR(SAFE_DIVIDE(rn - 1, grp_cnt - 1) * 11) + 1 AS STRING), 2, '0') || '-' || 
        LPAD(CAST(MOD(CAST(FLOOR(SAFE_DIVIDE(rn - 1, grp_cnt - 1) * 308) AS INT64), 28) + 1 AS STRING), 2, '0')
      ELSE '1970-01-01'
    END AS pub_date
  FROM docs_with_dates
),
pair_pub_dates AS (
  SELECT 
    pd.molregno_1,
    pd.molregno_2,
    pd.assay_id,
    pd.standard_type,
    MAX(pd2.pub_date) AS latest_pub_date
  FROM pair_docs pd
  JOIN pub_dates pd2 ON pd.doc_id = pd2.doc_id
  GROUP BY pd.molregno_1, pd.molregno_2, pd.assay_id, pd.standard_type
),
change_class AS (
  SELECT 
    pa.molregno_1,
    pa.molregno_2,
    pa.assay_id,
    pa.standard_type,
    pa.max_heavy_atoms,
    ppd.latest_pub_date,
    GREATEST(pa.max_doc_1, pa.max_doc_2) AS highest_doc_id,
    pa.smiles_1,
    pa.smiles_2,
    pa.avg_std_1,
    pa.avg_std_2,
    pa.activity_ids_1,
    pa.activity_ids_2,
    CASE 
      WHEN pa.avg_std_1 < pa.avg_std_2 THEN 'increase'
      WHEN pa.avg_std_1 > pa.avg_std_2 THEN 'decrease'
      ELSE 'no-change'
    END AS change_class
  FROM pair_agg pa
  JOIN pair_pub_dates ppd ON pa.molregno_1 = ppd.molregno_1 AND pa.molregno_2 = ppd.molregno_2 AND pa.assay_id = ppd.assay_id AND pa.standard_type = ppd.standard_type
)
SELECT 
  molregno_1,
  molregno_2,
  assay_id,
  standard_type,
  max_heavy_atoms,
  latest_pub_date,
  highest_doc_id,
  change_class,
  TO_HEX(MD5(TO_JSON_STRING(STRUCT(activity_ids_1, smiles_1)))) AS uuid_activity_smiles_1,
  TO_HEX(MD5(TO_JSON_STRING(STRUCT(activity_ids_2, smiles_2)))) AS uuid_activity_smiles_2,
  smiles_1,
  smiles_2
FROM change_class
ORDER BY assay_id, molregno_1, molregno_2

WITH user_first_session AS (
  SELECT 
    user_pseudo_id,
    MIN(PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', event_date)) AS first_session_date,
    DATE(TIMESTAMP_MICROS(user_first_touch_timestamp)) AS first_touch_date
  FROM `firebase-public-project.analytics_153293282.events_*`
  WHERE event_name = 'session_start'
    AND _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20180709' AND '20181002'
  GROUP BY user_pseudo_id, user_first_touch_timestamp
),
user_session_dates AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    user_pseudo_id,
    PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', event_date) AS session_date
  FROM `firebase-public-project.analytics_153293282.events_*`
  WHERE event_name = 'session_start'
    AND _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20180709' AND '20181002'
),
user_retention_check AS (
  SELECT 
    u.user_pseudo_id,
    u.first_session_date,
    u.first_touch_date,
    CASE WHEN sd.session_date IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS retained_week2
  FROM user_first_session u
  LEFT JOIN user_session_dates sd
    ON u.user_pseudo_id = sd.user_pseudo_id
    AND sd.session_date = DATE_ADD(u.first_session_date, INTERVAL 14 DAY)
),
cohort_weeks AS (
  SELECT 
    user_pseudo_id,
    first_session_date,
    first_touch_date,
    DATE_TRUNC(first_session_date, WEEK(MONDAY)) AS cohort_date,
    retained_week2
  FROM user_retention_check
)
SELECT 
  cohort_date,
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(retained_week2), COUNT(*)) * 100, 2) AS retention_rate
FROM cohort_weeks
WHERE cohort_date BETWEEN '2018-07-09' AND '2018-09-17'
GROUP BY cohort_date
ORDER BY cohort_date

WITH event_params_agg AS (
  SELECT
    event_date,
    (SELECT value.int_value FROM UNNEST(event_params) WHERE key = 'ga_session_id') AS ga_session_id_val,
    (SELECT value.string_value FROM UNNEST(event_params) WHERE key = 'campaign') AS campaign_name,
    traffic_source.medium,
    traffic_source.source,
    traffic_source.name
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ga4_obfuscated_sample_ecommerce.events_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20201201' AND '20201231'
),
sessions_per_source AS (
  SELECT 
    medium,
    source,
    name,
    campaign_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ga_session_id_val) AS session_count
  FROM event_params_agg
  GROUP BY medium, source, name, campaign_name
),
channel_classified AS (
  SELECT 
    medium,
    source,
    name,
    campaign_name,
    session_count,
    CASE
      WHEN source = '(direct)' AND medium IN ('(not set)', '(none)') THEN 'Direct'
      WHEN campaign_name IS NOT NULL AND campaign_name LIKE '%cross-network%' THEN 'Cross-network'
      WHEN (LOWER(source) IN ('alibaba', 'amazon', 'google shopping', 'shopify', 'etsy', 'ebay', 'stripe', 'walmart')
            OR (campaign_name IS NOT NULL AND REGEXP_CONTAINS(campaign_name, r'(^|[^a-df-z])shop|shopping')))
           AND REGEXP_CONTAINS(medium, r'cp|ppc|retargeting|paid') THEN 'Paid Shopping'
      WHEN (LOWER(source) IN ('baidu', 'bing', 'duckduckgo', 'ecosia', 'google', 'yahoo', 'yandex'))
           AND REGEXP_CONTAINS(medium, r'cp|ppc|paid') THEN 'Paid Search'
      WHEN (LOWER(source) IN ('badoo', 'facebook', 'fb', 'instagram', 'linkedin', 'pinterest', 'tiktok', 'twitter', 'whatsapp'))
           AND REGEXP_CONTAINS(medium, r'cp|ppc|retargeting|paid') THEN 'Paid Social'
      WHEN (LOWER(source) IN ('dailymotion', 'disneyplus', 'netflix', 'youtube', 'vimeo', 'twitch'))
           AND REGEXP_CONTAINS(medium, r'cp|ppc|retargeting|paid') THEN 'Paid Video'
      WHEN LOWER(medium) IN ('display', 'banner', 'expandable', 'interstitial', 'cpm') THEN 'Display'
      WHEN (LOWER(source) IN ('alibaba', 'amazon', 'google shopping', 'shopify', 'etsy', 'ebay', 'stripe', 'walmart')
            OR (campaign_name IS NOT NULL AND REGEXP_CONTAINS(campaign_name, r'(^|[^a-df-z])shop|shopping')))
           AND NOT REGEXP_CONTAINS(medium, r'cp|ppc|retargeting|paid') THEN 'Organic Shopping'
      WHEN (LOWER(source) IN ('badoo', 'facebook', 'fb', 'instagram', 'linkedin', 'pinterest', 'tiktok', 'twitter', 'whatsapp')
            OR LOWER(medium) IN ('social', 'social-network', 'social-media', 'sm', 'social network', 'social media'))
           AND NOT REGEXP_CONTAINS(medium, r'cp|ppc|retargeting|paid') THEN 'Organic Social'
      WHEN (LOWER(source) IN ('dailymotion', 'disneyplus', 'netflix', 'youtube', 'vimeo', 'twitch')
            OR REGEXP_CONTAINS(medium, r'video'))
           AND NOT REGEXP_CONTAINS(medium, r'cp|ppc|retargeting|paid') THEN 'Organic Video'
      WHEN (LOWER(source) IN ('baidu', 'bing', 'duckduckgo', 'ecosia', 'google', 'yahoo', 'yandex'))
           OR LOWER(medium) = 'organic' THEN 'Organic Search'
      WHEN LOWER(medium) = 'referral' THEN 'Referral'
      WHEN LOWER(source) IN ('email', 'e-mail', 'e_mail', 'e mail') OR LOWER(medium) IN ('email', 'e-mail', 'e_mail', 'e mail') THEN 'Email'
      WHEN LOWER(medium) = 'affiliate' THEN 'Affiliates'
      WHEN LOWER(medium) = 'audio' THEN 'Audio'
      WHEN LOWER(source) = 'sms' OR LOWER(medium) = 'sms' THEN 'SMS'
      WHEN REGEXP_CONTAINS(medium, r'push$') OR REGEXP_CONTAINS(medium, r'mobile|notification') THEN 'Mobile Push Notifications'
      ELSE 'Unassigned'
    END AS channel
  FROM sessions_per_source
)
SELECT 
  channel,
  SUM(session_count) AS total_sessions,
  ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(session_count) DESC) AS rank
FROM channel_classified
GROUP BY channel
ORDER BY rank

WITH sessions AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    CAST(ep.value.int_value AS STRING) as sess_id,

    traffic_source.source as source,
    traffic_source.name as name
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ga4_obfuscated_sample_ecommerce.events_202012*`,
  UNNEST(event_params) AS ep
  WHERE ep.key = 'ga_session_id'
    AND event_name = 'session_start'
),
channel_classified AS (
  SELECT 
    sess_id,
    CASE
      WHEN source = '(direct)' AND medium IN ('(not set)', '(none)') THEN 'Direct'
      WHEN LOWER(name) LIKE '%cross-network%' THEN 'Cross-network'
      WHEN (LOWER(source) IN ('alibaba', 'amazon', 'google shopping', 'shopify', 'etsy', 'ebay', 'stripe', 'walmart') 
            OR REGEXP_CONTAINS(LOWER(name), r'(^|[^a-df-z])shop|shopping'))
           AND REGEXP_CONTAINS(LOWER(medium), r'cp|ppc|retargeting|paid') THEN 'Paid Shopping'
      WHEN LOWER(source) IN ('baidu', 'bing', 'duckduckgo', 'ecosia', 'google', 'yahoo', 'yandex')
           AND REGEXP_CONTAINS(LOWER(medium), r'cp|ppc|paid') THEN 'Paid Search'
      WHEN REGEXP_CONTAINS(LOWER(source), r'badoo|facebook|fb|instagram|linkedin|pinterest|tiktok|twitter|whatsapp')
           AND REGEXP_CONTAINS(LOWER(medium), r'cp|ppc|retargeting|paid') THEN 'Paid Social'
      WHEN LOWER(source) IN ('dailymotion', 'disneyplus', 'netflix', 'youtube', 'vimeo', 'twitch')
           AND REGEXP_CONTAINS(LOWER(medium), r'cp|ppc|retargeting|paid') THEN 'Paid Video'
      WHEN LOWER(medium) IN ('display', 'banner', 'expandable', 'interstitial', 'cpm') THEN 'Display'
      WHEN (LOWER(source) IN ('alibaba', 'amazon', 'google shopping', 'shopify', 'etsy', 'ebay', 'stripe', 'walmart')
            OR REGEXP_CONTAINS(LOWER(name), r'(^|[^a-df-z])shop|shopping'))
           AND NOT REGEXP_CONTAINS(LOWER(medium), r'cp|ppc|retargeting|paid') THEN 'Organic Shopping'
      WHEN REGEXP_CONTAINS(LOWER(source), r'badoo|facebook|fb|instagram|linkedin|pinterest|tiktok|twitter|whatsapp')
           OR LOWER(medium) IN ('social', 'social-network', 'social-media', 'sm', 'social network', 'social media') THEN 'Organic Social'
      WHEN LOWER(source) IN ('dailymotion', 'disneyplus', 'netflix', 'youtube', 'vimeo', 'twitch')
           OR REGEXP_CONTAINS(LOWER(medium), r'video') THEN 'Organic Video'
      WHEN LOWER(source) IN ('baidu', 'bing', 'duckduckgo', 'ecosia', 'google', 'yahoo', 'yandex')
           OR LOWER(medium) = 'organic' THEN 'Organic Search'
      WHEN LOWER(medium) = 'referral' THEN 'Referral'
      WHEN LOWER(medium) IN ('email', 'e-mail', 'e_mail', 'e mail') OR LOWER(source) IN ('email', 'e-mail', 'e_mail', 'e mail') THEN 'Email'
      WHEN LOWER(medium) = 'affiliate' THEN 'Affiliates'
      WHEN LOWER(medium) = 'audio' THEN 'Audio'
      WHEN LOWER(source) = 'sms' OR LOWER(medium) = 'sms' THEN 'SMS'
      WHEN REGEXP_CONTAINS(LOWER(medium), r'push$') OR REGEXP_CONTAINS(LOWER(medium), r'mobile|notification') THEN 'Mobile Push Notifications'
      ELSE 'Unassigned'
    END as channel_group
  FROM sessions
)

FROM channel_classified
GROUP BY channel_group
ORDER BY session_count DESC

classified2 AS (
  SELECT
